family_guide.root_logic: 以 symphysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难识别的, 看不见的
lemmas.def_en: difficult or impossible to perceive or discern

examples.en: Through the dense evening fog, distant city lights became almost completely indiscernible.
examples.zh: 穿过浓重的晚雾，远处的城市灯火几乎完全无法辨识。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indiscernible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: presence of excess lipids in the blood

examples.en: Adopting a healthier lifestyle can help manage hyperlipidemia and reduce heart risks.
examples.zh: 采取更健康的生活方式有助于控制高脂血症并降低心脏病风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperlipidemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正确(性), 精密, 精确(性), 严格
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being exact

examples.en: The scientist recorded every measurement with great exactitude to prevent errors.
examples.zh: 这位科学家极其精确地记录了每一个测量值以防止出错。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exactitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可折闭的记事板, 可折闭的画
lemmas.def_en: a painting or carving (especially an altarpiece) on two panels (usually hinged like a book)

examples.en: The museum displayed a medieval diptych depicting the lives of saints.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅描绘圣徒生平的中世纪双联画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diptych 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the innermost membrane of an organ (especially the inner lining of an artery or vein or lymphatic vessel)

examples.en: Cholesterol deposits had begun to build up along the arterial intima.
examples.zh: 胆固醇沉积物已开始在动脉内膜上积聚。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the intima

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intima 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (anthropology) the distinctive expression of the cognitive or intellectual character of a culture or a social group

examples.en: Scholars discussed the cultural eidos that shaped this ancient civilization's worldview.
examples.zh: 学者们探讨了塑造这个古代文明世界观的文化表相。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eidos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 老耄, 老迷糊, 溺爱
lemmas.def_en: mental infirmity as a consequence of old age; sometimes shown by foolish infatuations

examples.en: In his dotage, the old king began to forget his closest allies.
examples.zh: 在年老昏聩之际，这位老国王开始遗忘他最亲密的盟友。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dotage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the recipient of funds or other benefits

examples.en: The legal contract required the donee to accept the charitable gift.
examples.zh: 法律合同要求受赠者接受这笔慈善赠予。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 donee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any polyhedron having twelve plane faces

examples.en: The artist designed a geometric sculpture shaped like a giant crystal dodecahedron.
examples.zh: 艺术家设计了一座形状像巨大水晶十二面体的几何雕塑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dodecahedron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (anatomy) any structure that resembles a horn in shape

examples.en: The anatomy instructor pointed out the anterior cornu of the lateral ventricle.
examples.zh: 解剖学讲师指出了侧脑室的前角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 荧光镜的使用, 荧光镜检查
lemmas.def_en: examination of body structures using a fluoroscope

examples.en: The doctor used real-time fluoroscopy to guide the placement of the catheter.
examples.zh: 医生使用实时荧光透视检查来引导导管的放置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fluoroscopy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very small northern fish; forage for sea birds and marine mammals and other fishes

examples.en: Flocks of seabirds swooped down to feed on the spawning caplin.
examples.zh: 成群的海鸟俯冲下来捕食正在产卵的毛鳞鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caplin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lively and brisk

examples.en: The canty old woman always greeted her neighbors with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 那位活泼开朗的老妇人总是带着温暖的微笑迎接邻居。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woodworker who specializes in making furniture

examples.en: A skilled cabinetmaker built this solid oak wardrobe entirely by hand.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的细木工匠纯手工打造了这个实木橡木衣柜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabinetmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the flesh of a chicken used for food

examples.en: Chef Poulet introduced a new dessert recipe at the culinary gala.
examples.zh: 波利特主厨在烹饪盛会上推出了一款新的甜点食谱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poulet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a label identifying the owner of a book in which it is pasted

examples.en: Inside the vintage novel was a personalized bookplate showing its original owner.
examples.zh: 这本老小说的内页贴着一张显示原主人的个性化藏书票。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookplate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being fermented

examples.en: Yeast feeds on fermentable sugars to produce carbon dioxide and alcohol.
examples.zh: 酵母以可发酵糖为食，产生二氧化碳和酒精。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fermentable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 跨文化的,适合于多种文化的,交叉文化的,涉及多种文化的
lemmas.def_en: extending through all human cultures

examples.en: The university program encourages transcultural dialogue among students from different countries.
examples.zh: 该大学项目鼓励来自不同国家的学生之间进行跨文化对话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transcultural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: made on a handloom

examples.en: She bought a colorful handwoven rug at the traditional artisan market.
examples.zh: 她在传统手工艺品市场上买了一块色彩斑斓的手工编织地毯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handwoven 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very evil man

examples.en: In Greek myth, Cerberus guarded the underworld like a terrifying hellhound.
examples.zh: 在希腊神话中，刻耳柏洛斯如同一只可怕的恶魔地狱犬般守卫着冥界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hellhound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various early blooming oleaceous shrubs of the genus Forsythia; native to eastern Asia and southern Europe but widely cultivated for their branches of bright yellow bell-shaped flowers

examples.en: The golden blossoms of the forsythia signalled the arrival of early spring.
examples.zh: 连翘的金黄色花朵标志着初春的到来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forsythia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1,000,000,000 periods per second

examples.en: The new processor operates at over three gigahertz for superior performance.
examples.zh: 新款处理器的运行频率超过三千兆赫，性能优异。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gigahertz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水上飞机, 水上滑艇, 水平舵
lemmas.def_en: an airplane that can land on or take off from water

examples.en: The military deployed a twin-engine hydroplane to conduct coastal search missions.
examples.zh: 军方部署了一架双发水上飞机执行沿海搜救任务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydroplane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奶奶, 老奶奶, 老婆婆, 外婆, 婆婆妈妈的人, 唠叨挑剔的人, 接生婆
lemmas.def_en: the mother of your father or mother

examples.en: My grannie baked delicious apple pies every Sunday for the entire family.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每个周日都为全家人烤美味的苹果派。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grannie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an advanced stage of pregnancy

examples.en: The biologist gently tagged the gravid turtle before she returned to sea.
examples.zh: 生物学家在那只怀孕的海龟返回大海前轻轻地给她做了标记。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gravid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a regular polygon formed by extending each of the sides of a regular hexagon to form two equilateral triangles

examples.en: The ancient stone amulet was engraved with a delicate hexagram symbol.
examples.zh: 古老的石质护身符上刻着一个精致的六角星图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hexagram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 8th letter of the Hebrew alphabet

examples.en: The scholar explained that heth is the eighth letter of the Hebrew alphabet.
examples.zh: 学者解释说，heth是希伯来字母表中的第八个字母。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血细胞比容, 血流比容计
lemmas.def_en: the ratio of the volume occupied by packed red blood cells to the volume of the whole blood as measured by a hematocrit

examples.en: The routine blood test showed that the patient had a normal hematocrit level.
examples.zh: 常规血液检查显示该患者的血细胞比容水平正常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hematocrit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a loft in a barn where hay is stored

examples.en: Barn owls often build their nests high up in the quiet hayloft.
examples.zh: 仓鸮经常在安静的干草棚高处筑巢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hayloft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海力空大号, 赫利孔山(文艺女神居地), 诗的灵感
lemmas.def_en: a tuba that coils over the shoulder of the musician

examples.en: The musician carried a heavy brass helicon during the military marching parade.
examples.zh: 乐手在阅兵游行中扛着一把沉重的铜制海力空大号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 helicon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having more than one story

examples.en: A new multistory parking garage will be built near the shopping center.
examples.zh: 购物中心附近将建造一座新的多层停车场。

lemmas.def_en: having more than one story

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multistory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an irritable petulant feeling

examples.en: His sudden burst of choler surprised everyone at the peaceful dinner table.
examples.zh: 他在平静的餐桌上突然勃然大怒，让所有人都大吃一惊。

lemmas.def_en: easily moved to anger; - H.G.Wells

examples.en: men of the choleric type take to kicking and smashing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 choler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cell that engulfs and digests debris and invading microorganisms

examples.en: A phagocyte is a specialized immune cell that engulfs harmful foreign bacteria.
examples.zh: 吞噬细胞是一种吞噬有害外来细菌的特化免疫细胞。

lemmas.def_zh: 噬吞细胞的, 有吞噬作用的
lemmas.def_en: capable of functioning as a phagocyte

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phagocyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 详细说明, 列举, 使特殊
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) To list or explain something in specific, individual detail.

examples.en: The contract should particularize the specific duties of each party involved clearly.
examples.zh: 合同应详细列明相关各方的具体职责。

lemmas.def_zh: 细说, 分列; 列举
lemmas.def_en: an individualized description of a particular instance

family_guide.root_logic: 以 particularize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 核, 细胞核, 核仁
lemmas.def_en: a small round body of protein in a cell nucleus; such organelles contain RNA and are involved in protein synthesis

examples.en: The biologist observed the dense nucleolus inside the cell nucleus under magnification.
examples.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下观察了细胞核内致密的核仁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nucleolus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a selfish person who is unwilling to give or spend

examples.en: The wealthy niggard refused to donate even a single dollar to charity.
examples.zh: 那个富有的吝啬鬼连一美元都不愿意捐给慈善机构。

lemmas.def_zh: 小气的, 吝啬的, 很少量的, 有限的
lemmas.def_en: petty or reluctant in giving or spending

examples.en: a niggardly tip

family_guide.root_logic: 以 niggard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (architecture) a triangular bracket of brick or stone (usually of slight extent)

examples.en: A carved stone corbel supported the weight of the medieval balcony above.
examples.zh: 一个雕花石托梁支撑着上方中世纪阳台的重量。

lemmas.def_en: having a corbel

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corbel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (US spelling of belabour) To explain or argue a point for too long until it becomes boring; to attack physically or verbally.

examples.en: The thugs threatened to belabor him if he did not hand over the cash.
examples.zh: 暴徒威胁说如果他不交出钱来就痛打他一顿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belabor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [宗]耶稣救世学, 救世神学
lemmas.def_en: the branch of Christian theology that deals with salvation as the effect of a divine agency

examples.en: Christian soteriology focuses on the theological study of salvation and divine grace.
examples.zh: 基督教救世学侧重于对救赎和神圣恩典的神学研究。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to soteriology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soteriology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a carving created by carving wood

examples.en: He admired the intricate traditional woodcarving displayed in the craft museum.
examples.zh: 他十分欣赏工艺博物馆中展示的精美传统木雕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodcarving 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a morbid fear of spiders

examples.en: Her severe arachnophobia makes it impossible for her to enter dark attics.
examples.zh: 严重的蜘蛛恐惧症使她根本不敢进入阴暗的阁楼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arachnophobia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棘爪, 制转杆, 卡爪
lemmas.def_en: a hinged catch that fits into a notch of a ratchet to move a wheel forward or prevent it from moving backward

examples.en: The ratchet mechanism slipped because the small metal pawl had worn out.
examples.zh: 由于小金属棘爪已经磨损，棘轮机构打滑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To sleep longer than you intended and wake up late.

examples.en: I set two loud alarms so that I would not oversleep tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我设了两个响亮的闹钟，以免明天睡过头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oversleep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or made of wood of the oak tree

examples.en: Heavy oaken doors protected the main entrance of the centuries-old monastery.
examples.zh: 沉重的橡木门护卫着这座数百年历史的修道院正门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oaken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无以匹敌的人, 无与伦比的事物
lemmas.def_en: model of excellence or perfection of a kind; one having no equal

examples.en: Critics hailed the master chef's latest dessert creation as a true nonesuch.
examples.zh: 评论家盛赞这位名厨最新的甜点作品是绝无仅有的杰作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nonesuch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blemish on the skin that is formed before birth

examples.en: The dermatologist carefully examined the dark nevus on the patient's shoulder.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生仔细检查了患者肩膀上的黑痣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nevus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: farthest down

examples.en: You will find the spare blankets neatly folded on the lowermost shelf.
examples.zh: 你会发现备用毯子整齐地叠放在最底层的架子上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lowermost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sanctioned by custom or morality especially sexual morality

examples.en: The government strictly monitors the production of licit pharmaceuticals for safety.
examples.zh: 政府出于安全考虑，严格监管合法药品的生产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 licit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large crested Old World plover having wattles and spurs

examples.en: A crested lapwing called loudly as it circled above the open marshland.
examples.zh: 一只凤头麦鸡在开阔的沼泽地上空盘旋并大声鸣叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lapwing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: light from a lamp

examples.en: She sat quietly by the window, reading a novel under the soft lamplight.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐在窗边，在柔和的灯光下读着小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lamplight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a skin condition marked by an overgrowth of layers of horny skin

examples.en: The dermatologist examined the rough patch on his arm and diagnosed actinic keratosis.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生检查了他手臂上的粗糙斑块，诊断为日光性角化病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keratosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马形水鬼(苏格兰民间传说中能诱人自溺或预告人们将溺死)
lemmas.def_en: (Scottish folklore) water spirit in the form of a horse that likes to drown its riders

examples.en: Scottish legends warn travelers not to ride the kelpie lurking near the dark loch.
examples.zh: 苏格兰传说告诫旅行者，不要骑乘潜伏在黑暗湖泊旁的马形水鬼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kelpie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 手提皮箱, 小皮包, (美)(非正式)屁股
lemmas.def_en: the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on

examples.en: He told the lazy dog to get off its keister and go outside.
examples.zh: 他让那只懒狗赶紧挪挪屁股，到外面去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杉木的一种或其木材[树脂]
lemmas.def_en: resin of the kauri trees of New Zealand; found usually as a fossil; also collected for making varnishes and linoleum

examples.en: The ancient forest is home to a massive kauri tree that spans centuries.
examples.zh: 这座古老的森林里生长着一棵历经数个世纪的巨大贝壳杉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kauri 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小公共汽车, 五分镍币
lemmas.def_en: a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport

examples.en: Commuters gathered at the street corner to catch the cheap morning jitney into town.
examples.zh: 通勤者聚集在街角，搭乘廉价的早班小巴进城。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jitney 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short crowbar

examples.en: The burglar used a heavy jemmy to force open the wooden back door.
examples.zh: 窃贼用一根粗重的撬棍撬开了木质后门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jemmy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可说明的, 可翻译的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being understood

examples.en: The complex data patterns were easily interpretable after the team applied the new algorithm.
examples.zh: 在团队应用新算法后，这些复杂的数据模式变得很容易理解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interpretable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无信仰, 不虔诚, 不孝
lemmas.def_en: unrighteousness by virtue of lacking respect for a god

examples.en: The ancient priest condemned the young soldier for his shocking impiety toward the gods.
examples.zh: 古老的祭司谴责这位年轻士兵对神明令人震惊的不敬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impiety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纷乱, 纠葛, 一团糟
lemmas.def_en: an intricate and confusing interpersonal or political situation

examples.en: The company tried hard to avoid getting involved in the bitter political imbroglio.
examples.zh: 公司极力避免卷入这场激烈的政治纠葛之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imbroglio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 医原性的, 受医师影响的
lemmas.def_en: induced by a physician's words or therapy (used especially of a complication resulting from treatment)

examples.en: The patient suffered from an iatrogenic infection following the routine hospital surgical procedure.
examples.zh: 该患者在医院常规手术后发生了医源性感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iatrogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不认真的, 无兴趣的, 不热心的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing little interest or enthusiasm

examples.en: He made a halfhearted attempt to apologize, but nobody believed he was truly sorry.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心地试图道歉，但没人相信他是真心悔过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 halfhearted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Italian game similar to tennis

examples.en: Villagers gathered on the square to watch the traditional Italian game of pallone.
examples.zh: 村民们聚集在广场上，观看传统的意大利帕龙球比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pallone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several low-growing pines of western North America

examples.en: We gathered dried pinyon wood to build a fragrant campfire in the desert.
examples.zh: 我们收集了干燥的矮松木，在沙漠中燃起一堆芬芳的篝火。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinyon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 非常嘹亮的, 最强音的
lemmas.def_en: chiefly a direction or description in music

examples.en: The orchestra reached a thrilling fortissimo climax that resonated throughout the entire hall.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队达到了震撼的最强音高潮，在整个大厅内回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fortissimo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ribbed fabric used in clothing and upholstery

examples.en: He bought a crisp poplin shirt that felt remarkably cool in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 他买了一件爽挺的府绸衬衫，在夏日炎炎中感觉格外凉爽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poplin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the vulva

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized medical care for patients experiencing persistent vulvar discomfort.
examples.zh: 该诊所为持续出现外阴不适的患者提供专业的医疗护理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vulvar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the wife or widow of a czar

examples.en: The tsarina wore an exquisite silk gown adorned with precious diamonds and pearls.
examples.zh: 沙皇皇后身着一袭镶嵌着珍贵钻石和珍珠的精致丝绸长裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tsarina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (anatomy / geography) To cut across or divide something transversely.

examples.en: The researchers laid down a straight line to transect the coastal forest area.
examples.zh: 研究人员划定了一条直线，以横切该沿海森林区域进行调查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used of girls; wild and boisterous

examples.en: As a child, she preferred tomboyish clothes and playing football with the neighborhood boys.
examples.zh: 小时候，她更喜欢偏男孩子气的打扮，并和邻里男孩一起踢足球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tomboyish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an extremely bright star of very large diameter and low density

examples.en: Astronomers used the powerful telescope to study a distant red supergiant near its end.
examples.zh: 天文学家使用强大的望远镜来研究一颗接近生命终点的遥远红超巨星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supergiant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 傲慢的, 自大的, 目空一切的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.L.Shirer

examples.en: The waiter gave us a supercilious look when we asked for tap water.
examples.zh: 当我们索要自来水时，服务员露出了轻蔑傲慢的神情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supercilious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: designating sound transmission from two sources through two channels

examples.en: The classic album sounded magnificent through the newly installed modern stereophonic sound system.
examples.zh: 通过新安装的现代立体声音响系统，这张经典专辑听起来棒极了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stereophonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: made of lamb

examples.en: We ordered grilled pork souvlaki served with warm pita bread and garlic sauce.
examples.zh: 我们点了烤猪肉串，搭配温热的皮塔饼和大蒜酱食用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 souvlaki 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the underside of a part of a building (such as an arch or overhang or beam etc.)

examples.en: He noticed that birds were nesting in the wooden soffit beneath the roof.
examples.zh: 他注意到有鸟儿在屋檐下方的木质拱腹内筑巢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soffit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 破烂的, 马虎的, 潦草的
lemmas.def_en: marked by great carelessness

examples.en: The editor rejected the manuscript due to its slipshod research and frequent factual errors.
examples.zh: 由于研究草率且事实错误频出，编辑退回了这份稿件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slipshod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a measuring instrument for detecting and measuring the intensity and direction and duration of movements of the ground (as an earthquake)

examples.en: The sensitive seismograph detected minor tremors hours before the major earthquake struck the coast.
examples.zh: 在主震袭击海岸数小时前，灵敏的地震仪就探测到了微弱的震动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seismograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous spiny large-headed usually scaleless scorpaenoid fishes with broad mouths

examples.en: The fisherman caught a spiny sculpin hiding among the rocks in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 渔夫在浅水区的岩石间捕获了一条带刺的杜父鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sculpin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能笑的, 善笑的, 爱笑的
lemmas.def_en: arousing or provoking laughter

examples.en: His absurd explanation for being late was met with risible smirks from his coworkers.
examples.zh: 他对迟到做出的荒谬解释引来了同事们可笑的窃笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 risible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to a recession

examples.en: The company introduced strict cost-cutting measures to survive the harsh recessionary climate.
examples.zh: 公司出台了严格的削减成本措施，以在严峻的衰退环境中生存下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recessionary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 解脱, 生命的终止, 偿清
lemmas.def_en: euphemisms for death (based on an analogy between lying in a bed and in a tomb)

examples.en: The sudden cancellation of the contract finally gave a quietus to their struggling business.
examples.zh: 合同的突然取消最终彻底终结了他们苦苦支撑的业务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quietus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cubelike object

examples.en: The paleontologist carefully examined the fossilized quadrate bone to identify the dinosaur species.
examples.zh: 古生物学家仔细检查了这块方骨化石，以确定该恐龙的物种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a term formerly used to refer to the simple past tense

examples.en: Students must learn how to form the preterite tense to describe past completed actions.
examples.zh: 学生必须学会如何构成过去时态，来描述过去已完成的动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preterite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有权的人, 有势力的人, 统治者
lemmas.def_en: a ruler who is unconstrained by law

examples.en: The foreign potentate arrived with a large entourage of advisors, guards, and diplomats.
examples.zh: 这位外国统治者带领着由顾问、卫兵和外交官组成的庞大随从团抵达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potentate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: following a meal (especially dinner)

examples.en: A brief postprandial walk through the quiet garden helped aid her digestion after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐后在安静的花园里进行短暂的散步有助于她的消化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postprandial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who works underwater

examples.en: A military frogman was deployed to inspect the damaged hull beneath the navy vessel.
examples.zh: 一名军方蛙人被派去检查海军舰艇下方受损的船体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frogman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 航路标志灯船, 灯塔船
lemmas.def_en: a ship equipped like a lighthouse and anchored where a permanent lighthouse would be impracticable

examples.en: The old lightship guided incoming vessels safely away from the treacherous submerged reef.
examples.zh: 那艘老灯船指引着进港船只安全避开危险的暗礁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lightship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 走读生, 走读医学实习生
lemmas.def_en: a nonresident doctor or medical student; connected with a hospital but not living there

examples.en: As a hospital extern, she gained valuable clinical experience while completing her final studies.
examples.zh: 作为一名医院走读实习生，她在完成最后学业的同时获得了宝贵的临床经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several shrubs or small evergreen trees having solitary white or pink or reddish flowers

examples.en: A single white camelia blossomed beside the stone path, filling the garden with quiet beauty.
examples.zh: 一朵白色的山茶花在石径旁绽放，让花园充满静谧之美。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camelia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: vain and empty boasting

examples.en: His speech was filled with empty braggadocio rather than any real, achievable policy proposals.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充斥着空洞的自夸，而没有任何实际可行的政策建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 braggadocio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spar projecting from the bow of a vessel

examples.en: A large carved figurehead was proudly mounted directly beneath the wooden ship's long bowsprit.
examples.zh: 一个巨大的雕刻船首像自豪地安装在这艘木船长长的船首斜桁正下方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bowsprit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause of e.g. European and African relapsing fever

examples.en: Ticks can transmit Borrelia bacteria, which are responsible for causing debilitating Lyme disease.
examples.zh: 蜱虫会传播包柔氏螺旋体菌，这种细菌会导致令人衰弱的莱姆病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 borrelia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ out) To make a harsh, loud bleating or blaring noise, or blurt out indiscreetly.

examples.en: The frightened sheep began to blat loudly when the stray dog approached the pen.
examples.zh: 当流浪狗靠近羊圈时，受惊的羊开始大声咩咩叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: eyeglasses having two focal lengths, one for near vision and the other for far vision

examples.en: After struggling to read the menu, my grandfather decided it was time for bifocals.
examples.zh: 看菜单费劲之后，我祖父觉得该去配一副双光眼镜了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bifocals 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of 4 vertical supports at the corners of a bedstead

examples.en: She absentmindedly tied a colorful silk ribbon around the ornate wooden bedpost in her room.
examples.zh: 她心不在焉地将一根彩色丝带系在房间里华丽的木制床柱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedpost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三节联韵诗, 叙事曲
lemmas.def_en: a poem consisting of 3 stanzas and an envoy

examples.en: The poet recited an emotional ballade that told the tragic story of two lovers.
examples.zh: 诗人朗诵了一首感人至深的三节联韵诗，讲述了两个恋人的悲剧故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: trivial nonsense

examples.en: He dismissed the bizarre conspiracy theory as pure balderdash that deserved no serious attention.
examples.zh: 他斥责那种离奇的阴谋论纯属胡说八道，根本不值一驳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balderdash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold

examples.en: The delicious aroma of fresh sourdough bread drifted from the neighborhood bakehouse every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨，新鲜酵母面包的诱人香气都会从附近的烘坊飘散开来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bakehouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 行话, 俚语, 黑话
lemmas.def_en: a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves)

examples.en: The detective was familiar with the local criminal argot used in the intercepted text messages.
examples.zh: 这名侦探非常熟悉被拦截短信中使用的当地犯罪行话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 argot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tree of the genus Eucalyptus

examples.en: The koala slept peacefully among the branches of a tall eucalypt.
examples.zh: 考拉在一棵高大的桉树枝桠间安详地睡着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eucalypt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: defensive against enemy submarines

examples.en: Naval helicopters conducted intensive antisubmarine patrols across the coastal waters.
examples.zh: 海军直升机在沿海水域进行了密集的反潜巡逻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antisubmarine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: personal state of isolation and anxiety resulting from a lack of social control and regulation

examples.en: Rapid industrialization often leads to widespread social anomie and moral confusion.
examples.zh: 快速的工业化往往会导致广泛的社会失范和道德迷茫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anomie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the stage of meiosis or mitosis when chromosomes move toward opposite ends of the nuclear spindle

examples.en: Chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles during mitotic anaphase.
examples.zh: 在有丝分裂后期，染色单体分离并移向两极。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anaphase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an integer that is an exact divisor of some quantity

examples.en: The technician carefully measured an aliquot of the sample for testing.
examples.zh: 技术人员仔细量取了一等份样品用于检测。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aliquot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gun that propels a projectile by compressed air

examples.en: The boy practiced his target shooting in the backyard using an airgun.
examples.zh: 那个男孩在后院用气枪练习打靶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airgun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the right in English law of presenting a nominee to a vacant ecclesiastical benefice

examples.en: The wealthy landowner retained the historic advowson for the local parish church.
examples.zh: 这位富有的地主保留了当地教区教堂的历史圣职推荐权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 advowson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: recklessness in politics or foreign affairs

examples.en: Critics condemned the military intervention as dangerous and irresponsible foreign adventurism.
examples.zh: 批评人士谴责这次军事干预是危险且不负责任的对外冒险主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adventurism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman's dress style that imitates the caftan cloaks worn by men in the Near East

examples.en: She wore an embroidered silk caftan to the seaside evening party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件刺绣丝绸长袍去参加海滨晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caftan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]运用不能症, 精神性失用症
lemmas.def_en: inability to make purposeful movements

examples.en: Following his severe stroke, he developed apraxia affecting his daily motor skills.
examples.zh: 严重中风后，他患上了影响日常运动技能的失用症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apraxia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a round bump on a bone where it forms a joint with another bone

examples.en: The surgeon repaired the fractured lateral condyle of the patient's femur.
examples.zh: 外科医生修复了患者股骨骨折的外侧髁。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a condyle

examples.en: The surgeon repaired the broken condylar joint to restore full jaw mobility.
examples.zh: 外科医生修复了受损的髁突关节，以恢复下颌的全部活动能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 condyle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ordinal number of eighty in counting order

examples.en: The entire family gathered to celebrate their grandmother's eightieth birthday.
examples.zh: 全家人聚在一起庆祝祖母的八十岁大寿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eightieth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to

examples.en: He had the effrontery to demand a promotion despite his terrible performance.
examples.zh: 尽管业绩糟糕，他竟然还有脸要求升职。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 effrontery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 河口, 管乐器之吹奏口
lemmas.def_en: the aperture of a wind instrument into which the player blows directly

examples.en: The young flute player spent weeks perfecting her lip embouchure.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的长笛演奏者花了数周时间完善她的吹奏口型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embouchure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: imprisonment (especially for a long time)

examples.en: The captured spy was held in durance until the war ended.
examples.zh: 被俘虏的间谍一直被监禁，直到战争结束。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 durance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 悬钩子属植物, 露莓
lemmas.def_en: any of several trailing blackberry brambles especially of North America

examples.en: We picked ripe dewberries along the sunny edge of the old forest.
examples.zh: 我们在老森林阳光明媚的边缘采摘成熟的露莓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dewberry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Delphinium having palmately divided leaves and showy spikes of variously colored spurred flowers; some contain extremely poisonous substances

examples.en: Tall blue delphiniums bloomed magnificently along the garden wall this summer.
examples.zh: 高大的蓝色飞燕草今年夏天在花园围墙边绚丽绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delphinium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leather from the hide of a deer

examples.en: He wore a pair of soft deerskin gloves to protect his hands.
examples.zh: 他戴着一副柔软的鹿皮手套来保护双手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deerskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a risky and uncertain venture

examples.en: Investing in early-stage tech startups is often an unpredictable crapshoot.
examples.zh: 投资初创科技企业往往是一场难以预测的冒险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crapshoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 绳索, 船上索具, 某一指定地区的木材总数
lemmas.def_en: the amount of wood in an area as measured in cords

examples.en: Sailors inspected the worn cordage before embarking on the long voyage.
examples.zh: 水手们在启程远航前检查了磨损的绳索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cordage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 椰子, 椰子肉, 椰子果, 头, 脑袋
lemmas.def_en: large hard-shelled oval nut with a fibrous husk containing thick white meat surrounding a central cavity filled (when fresh) with fluid or milk

examples.en: Fresh milk from the green cocoanut tasted wonderfully sweet and refreshing.
examples.zh: 青椰子里的新鲜椰汁喝起来甘甜清爽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocoanut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the chemical group that gives color to a molecule

examples.en: Modifying the chemical chromophore altered the overall color of the synthetic dye.
examples.zh: 改变化学发色团 alters 了合成染料的整体颜色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chromophore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: movement by a cell or organism in reaction to a chemical stimulus

examples.en: Bacteria use chemotaxis to swim toward higher concentrations of vital nutrients.
examples.zh: 细菌利用趋化性游向浓度更高的重要营养源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chemotaxis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a conveyer belt that carries luggage to be claimed by air travelers

examples.en: Laughing children rode the brightly painted horses on the vintage carrousel.
examples.zh: 笑着的孩子们骑着复古旋转木马上色彩斑斓的木马。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carrousel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 如歌的, 轻柔流畅的
lemmas.def_en: smooth and flowing

examples.en: The violinist played the slow movement with a warm, cantabile tone that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 小提琴手以温暖如歌的音色演奏了慢板乐章，打动了观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantabile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 心和肺的, 心脏呼吸的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or affecting both the heart and the lungs and their functions

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise significantly improves cardiorespiratory fitness and overall stamina in older adults.
examples.zh: 规律的有氧运动能显著提高老年人的心肺健康水平和整体耐力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardiorespiratory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) the tendency of an atom or radical to attract electrons in the formation of an ionic bond

examples.en: Fluorine has the highest electronegativity of all elements on the periodic table.
examples.zh: 氟是元素周期表中电负性最高的元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electronegativity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any agent that interferes with normal embryonic development: alcohol or thalidomide or X-rays or rubella are examples

examples.en: Certain medications act as a potent teratogen and must be avoided during pregnancy.
examples.zh: 某些药物是强效致畸剂，怀孕期间必须避免使用。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to substances or agents that can interfere with normal embryonic development

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teratogen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being determined or limited or fixed

examples.en: The exact cause of the mechanical failure is not determinable without further testing.
examples.zh: 如果不做进一步测试，机械故障的确切原因便无法确定。

lemmas.def_zh: 未定的, 不可测定的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being definitely decided or ascertained

family_guide.root_logic: 以 determinable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without flavoring added

examples.en: She prefers drinking unflavored sparkling water instead of sugary sodas every afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每天下午更喜欢喝原味气泡水，而不是含糖汽水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unflavored 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使成团, 使成块, 使聚结；成团, 成块, 聚结
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To collect or gather together into a dense, rounded mass or cluster.

examples.en: Tiny dust particles slowly agglomerate into larger clumps within the filtration system.
examples.zh: 微小的灰尘颗粒在过滤系统内慢慢聚结成更大的团块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agglomerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To wear clothes that are too casual or not warm enough for an occasion or weather.

examples.en: I worried that I might underdress for the formal gala in my simple suit.
examples.zh: 我担心自己穿着这套简朴的西装参加正式晚宴会显得过于随便。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underdress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has taught himself

examples.en: As a brilliant autodidact, he mastered four foreign languages entirely on his own.
examples.zh: 作为一名出色的自学者，他完全靠自己掌握了四门外语。

lemmas.def_zh: 自学(者)的；靠自学获得的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the characteristics of an autodidact

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autodidact 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 报答, 酬答, 还礼
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal or literary) To return a favor, kindness, or love ('unrequited love'), or punish a wrong.

examples.en: He hoped that she would eventually requite his deep affection and unwavering loyalty.
examples.zh: 他希望她最终能回报他深厚的情意和坚定的忠诚。

lemmas.def_en: a justly deserved penalty

family_guide.root_logic: 以 requite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the flat bone that articulates with the clavicles and the first seven pairs of ribs

examples.en: The patient experienced a sharp pain behind his breastbone after lifting heavy weights.
examples.zh: 患者在搬抬重物后，胸骨后方感到一阵剧痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breastbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a written symbol that is used to represent speech

examples.en: In written English, the letter combination 'sh' represents a single phonological grapheme.
examples.zh: 在英语书写中，字母组合“sh”代表一个单独的音位字素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grapheme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞页, 章节前后的空白
lemmas.def_en: a blank leaf in the front or back of a book

examples.en: The author wrote a personal inscription on the front flyleaf of the book.
examples.zh: 作者在书本的前飞页上写下了一段个人题词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flyleaf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tiredness of the eyes caused by prolonged close work by a person with an uncorrected vision problem

examples.en: Staring at computer screens for hours without breaks often leads to severe eyestrain.
examples.zh: 连续数小时盯着电脑屏幕不休息往往会导致严重的眼疲劳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyestrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a granular crystalline intrusive rock

examples.en: Ancient sculptors frequently used durable diorite to carve statues and royal monuments.
examples.zh: 古代雕塑家经常使用坚硬的闪长岩来雕刻雕像和皇家纪念碑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diorite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胸甲, 铁甲, 装甲板
lemmas.def_en: medieval body armor that covers the chest and back

examples.en: The museum displays a steel cuirass that protected soldiers during the Renaissance.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一件在文艺复兴时期保护士兵的钢制胸甲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuirass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of a continent that is stable and forms the central mass of the continent; typically Precambrian

examples.en: Geologists discovered extremely ancient mineral deposits preserved deep within the continental craton.
examples.zh: 地质学家在大陆克拉通深处发现了保存完好的古老矿藏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 craton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf) shaped like a heart

examples.en: The climbing ivy is easily recognized by its distinctive, dark green cordate leaves.
examples.zh: 这种爬山虎很容易通过其特有的深绿色心形叶片辨认出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cordate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a supplement to a will; a testamentary instrument intended to alter an already executed will

examples.en: He added a brief codicil to his will to include his new grandson.
examples.zh: 他在遗嘱中添加了一份简短附录，将新出生的小孙子包括在内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 codicil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any orchid of the genus Cattleya characterized by a three-lobed lip enclosing the column; among the most popular and most extravagantly beautiful orchids known

examples.en: A stunning purple cattleya bloomed gracefully in the humid corner of the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 一株令人惊叹的紫色卡特兰在温室湿润的角落里优雅地盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cattleya 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any general reduction in vitality and strength of body and mind resulting from a debilitating chronic disease

examples.en: The advanced cancer caused severe cachexia, leaving the patient frail and bedridden.
examples.zh: 晚期癌症导致了严重的恶病质，使患者虚弱不堪且卧床不起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cachexia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variant of `burden'

examples.en: The weary traveler could no longer carry the heavy burthen upon his shoulders.
examples.zh: 疲惫的旅人再也无法承受肩上沉重的重负了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burthen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inability to experience pleasure

examples.en: Severe depression is often accompanied by anhedonia, making once-loved hobbies feel completely pointless.
examples.zh: 重度抑郁症通常伴有快感缺乏，使曾经热爱的爱好显得毫无意义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anhedonia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [尤美国俚语、口语]愚蠢的, 傻的, 笨的
lemmas.def_en: (used informally) stupid

examples.en: He made a boneheaded mistake by deleting the final report without saving.
examples.zh: 他犯了个极愚蠢的错误，没保存就把最终报告删了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boneheaded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bowl for baptismal water

examples.en: Tourists gathered around the ancient baptistery to admire its detailed marble carvings.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在古老的洗礼堂周围，欣赏精致的大理石雕刻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baptistery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 堰, 堰下的水塘, 鞭打者
lemmas.def_en: a driver who urges the animals on with lashes of a whip

examples.en: Water rushed noisily over the river lasher after days of heavy rain.
examples.zh: 连日暴雨之后，河水哗哗地冲过了拦河堰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lasher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a support that you can lean against while sitting

examples.en: Adjust the ergonomic backrest to keep your posture straight during long drives.
examples.zh: 调整这个符合人体工学的靠背，以便在长途驾驶时保持端正坐姿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backrest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lighting from behind

examples.en: The photographer used soft backlighting to create a radiant halo around her hair.
examples.zh: 摄影师运用柔和的逆光，在她的发丝周围营造出一圈光晕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backlighting 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lung disease caused by inhaling asbestos particles

examples.en: The retired shipyard worker was diagnosed with asbestosis after years of exposure.
examples.zh: 那名退休造船厂工人在暴露多年后被确诊患有石棉肺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asbestosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several tall tropical palms native to southeastern Asia having egg-shaped nuts

examples.en: Tall areca palms lined the tropical avenue, swaying gently in the ocean breeze.
examples.zh: 高大的槟榔树排列在热带林荫道两侧，在海风中轻轻摇曳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 areca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柱顶过梁, 门窗的头线条板
lemmas.def_en: the molding around a door or window

examples.en: Classical stone columns supported the heavy architrave above the grand temple entrance.
examples.zh: 古典石柱支撑着宏伟寺庙入口上方沉重的柱顶过梁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 architrave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 会吏总的监察区, 会吏总的职位
lemmas.def_en: the territorial jurisdiction of an archdeacon

examples.en: He oversaw dozens of historic rural parishes across the expansive northern archdeaconry.
examples.zh: 他负责监管这片广袤的北部副主教管区内数十个历史悠久的乡村堂区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archdeaconry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 止汗剂; 防汗剂; 抑汗剂
lemmas.def_en: an astringent substance applied to the skin to reduce perspiration

examples.en: Apply this clinical antiperspirant in the morning to stay dry and fresh all day.
examples.zh: 早晨涂抹这款医用止汗剂，能让你整天保持干爽清新。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiperspirant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人类的, 有关人类的
lemmas.def_en: relating to mankind or the period of mankind's existence

examples.en: Cosmologists often reference the anthropic principle to explain fundamental physical constants.
examples.zh: 宇宙学家经常引用人择原理来解释基本物理常数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthropic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: planned in advance

examples.en: The prosecutor proved that the suspect acted with malice aforethought during the crime.
examples.zh: 检察官证明了嫌疑人在作案时具有预谋恶意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aforethought 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: person's predisposition to be affected by something (as a disease)

examples.en: The clinical exam revealed an asthenic habitus, typical of individuals with this genetic disorder.
examples.zh: 临床检查显示出典型的瘦弱体型，这是该遗传病患者的常见特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 habitus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a male attendant of the bridegroom at a wedding

examples.en: His best friend proudly stood beside him as a groomsman on the wedding day.
examples.zh: 在婚礼当天，他最好的朋友自豪地作为男傧相站在他身旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groomsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a self-service laundry (service mark Laundromat) where coin-operated washing machines are available to individual customers

examples.en: I spent Sunday morning reading a paperback novel at the local coin-operated launderette.
examples.zh: 周日早晨，我在当地的投币式自助洗衣店里读着一本平装小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 launderette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any tumor derived from cells of the nervous system

examples.en: Persistent sharp pain in her foot led the doctor to suspect a small neuroma.
examples.zh: 她脚部持续的剧烈刺痛让医生怀疑是长了小神经瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neuroma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不稳的小立足点, 克服困难的办法, 微小的优势
lemmas.def_en: a relatively insignificant position from which future progress might be made

examples.en: The startup finally gained a solid toehold in the competitive Asian technology market.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司终于在竞争激烈的亚洲科技市场中站稳了脚跟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toehold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 定标器, 攀登者, 刮刀, 过秤者, 刮鳞人
lemmas.def_en: an electronic pulse counter used to count pulses that occur too rapidly to be recorded individually

examples.en: The dentist used an ultrasonic scaler to remove stubborn plaque from the teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医使用超声波洁牙器去除了牙齿上顽固的菌斑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scaler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the musical interval between adjacent keys on a keyboard instrument

examples.en: Lowering the pitch by a single semitone transformed the chord into a minor key.
examples.zh: 将音高降低一个半音，便将和弦变成了小调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semitone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 戴了眼镜的, 有眼镜状斑纹的
lemmas.def_en: wearing, or having the face adorned with, eyeglasses or an eyeglass

examples.en: A quiet, spectacled young man sat in the corner reading an old leather-bound volume.
examples.zh: 一位文静的戴眼镜青年坐在角落里，翻阅一本旧皮面书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spectacled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an employee of a theater who performs work involved in putting on a theatrical production

examples.en: An experienced stagehand quickly shifted the heavy scenery during the brief blackout.
examples.zh: 一名经验丰富的舞台工作人员在短暂的暗场期间迅速调换了沉重的布景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stagehand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使止血, 止住, 止血
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (US variant spelling of staunch) To stop the flow of blood from a wound, or halt a loss.

examples.en: The medic pressed a sterile dressing firmly against the wound to stanch the bleeding.
examples.zh: 医务人员将无菌敷料紧压在伤口上以止血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stanch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: obstreperous

examples.en: The tired toddler got quite stroppy when told it was time for his nap.
examples.zh: 那个疲倦的幼童在被告知该午睡时变得十分刁蛮任性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stroppy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大折合式刀, 屈体跳水
lemmas.def_en: a large knife with one or more folding blades

examples.en: He pulled a sharp jackknife from his pocket to cut the thick packaging twine.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一把锋利的大折刀，割断了厚重的包装麻绳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jackknife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots

examples.en: Morning dew sparkled across the lush green sward of the public park.
examples.zh: 晨露在公园郁郁葱葱的绿草地上闪烁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [鸟](中美洲产的艳羽鸣禽)唐纳雀
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous New World woodland birds having brightly colored males

examples.en: A scarlet tanager perched quietly on the branch before singing its sweet song.
examples.zh: 一只猩红唐纳雀静静地停在树枝上，随后唱起了悦耳的歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tanager 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the process of breaking up and dissolving blood clots

examples.en: Emergency thrombolysis was performed immediately to restore normal blood flow to the patient.
examples.zh: 医生立即实施了紧急溶栓以恢复患者的正常血流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thrombolysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可转移的, 可转换的, 可传递的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being moved or conveyed from one place to another

examples.en: These train tickets are non-refundable and are not transferrable to any other passenger.
examples.zh: 这些火车票不可退款，也不得转让给其他任何乘客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transferrable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cord that is pulled to open the gasbag of a balloon wide enough to release gas and so causes the balloon to descend

examples.en: He counted three seconds after jumping before firmly pulling the parachute ripcord.
examples.zh: 跳伞后他数了三秒，然后果断拉下了开伞索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ripcord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可翻下部分, 拒绝, 低落
lemmas.def_en: the act of refusing an offer

examples.en: After facing a sudden turndown from the bank, they sought alternative funding sources.
examples.zh: 遭到银行的突然拒绝后，他们转而寻求其他资金来源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turndown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超现代的, 最新的, 极时髦的
lemmas.def_en: extremely modern

examples.en: The company moved its headquarters into an ultramodern building equipped with smart technology.
examples.zh: 公司将总部迁入了一座配备智能技术的超现代建筑中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultramodern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or involving a single element or component

examples.en: In computer programming, the exclamation mark is often used as a unary operator.
examples.zh: 在计算机编程中，感叹号通常用作一元运算符。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of unknown regions) not yet surveyed or investigated

examples.en: The brave explorers ventured deep into the unmapped wilderness beyond the high mountains.
examples.zh: 勇敢的探险家们深入高山之外那片未绘制地图的荒野。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unmapped 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未亵渎的, 未受侵犯的, 无污点的
lemmas.def_en: (of a woman) having the hymen unbroken

examples.en: The ancient temple grounds remained inviolate despite centuries of continuous political turmoil.
examples.zh: 尽管经历了数百年的政治动荡，这座古老的寺庙区依然未受侵犯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inviolate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未受到照顾的, 被忽略了的
lemmas.def_en: lacking care and attention

examples.en: The untended garden was completely overrun by tall weeds and wild climbing vines.
examples.zh: 疏于照管的花园里完全长满了杂草和疯长的野藤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 untended 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胎生的, 母体发芽的
lemmas.def_en: producing living young (not eggs)

examples.en: Most common mammals are viviparous, giving birth to live young instead of eggs.
examples.zh: 大多数常见哺乳动物是胎生的，产下活体幼崽而非卵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viviparous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a horny material from the upper jaws of certain whales; used as the ribs of fans or as stays in corsets

examples.en: Historical dresses often used stiff whalebone to maintain the dramatic shape of corsets.
examples.zh: 历史上的服饰常使用硬鲸须来维持紧身胸衣的夸张廓形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whalebone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of something having a dusty purplish pink color

examples.en: The early sunrise bathed the quiet mountain valley in a soft roseate glow.
examples.zh: 初升的旭日将宁静的山谷沐浴在柔和的玫瑰色光芒中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roseate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冗长的废话, 繁琐费时的手续
lemmas.def_en: a set of confused and meaningless statements

examples.en: I had to go through a tedious bureaucratic rigmarole just to renew my visa.
examples.zh: 为了续签签证，我不得不经历一套繁琐冗长的高效流程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rigmarole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acute viral disease of the nervous system of warm-blooded animals (usually transmitted by the bite of a rabid animal); rabies is fatal if the virus reaches the brain

examples.en: The veterinarian suspected the wild animal was suffering from the deadly lyssa virus.
examples.zh: 兽医怀疑这只野生动物感染了致命的狂犬病毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lyssa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a star with 5 points; formed by 5 straight lines between the vertices of a pentagon and enclosing another pentagon

examples.en: She wore a small silver pentacle around her neck as a protective amulet.
examples.zh: 她脖子上戴着一个小小的银色五角星符，用作护身符。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentacle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使……成为主流（mainstreamed是mainstream的过去形式）
lemmas.def_en: (of the handicapped) placed in regular school classes

examples.en: Alternative rock was fully mainstreamed by the mid-1990s, dominating commercial radio stations nationwide.
examples.zh: 另类摇滚在20世纪90年代中期完全成为主流，风靡全国各大商业电台。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mainstreamed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 关着栏栅的部落, 牛栏
lemmas.def_en: a village of huts for native Africans in southern Africa; usually surrounded by a stockade

examples.en: The local herdsmen guided their cattle safely into the wooden kraal before nightfall.
examples.zh: 当地牧民在天黑前将牛群安全地赶进了木栅栏牛栏中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kraal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fitting reward

examples.en: The brave soldiers received their rightful meed of praise after the difficult battle.
examples.zh: 艰苦的战斗过后，勇敢的士兵们获得了他们应得的赞赏嘉奖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stupid foolish person

examples.en: Do not act like a timid ninny when making such an important decision.
examples.zh: 在做如此重要的决定时，不要表现得像个胆怯的傻子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ninny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疼痛的, 有疼痛反映的
lemmas.def_en: caused by or in response to pain

examples.en: Specialized nociceptive neurons quickly transmit pain signals from the skin to the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 特化的伤害感受神经元会迅速将疼痛信号从皮肤传递到脊髓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nociceptive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flight by an aircraft over a particular area (especially over an area in foreign territory)

examples.en: The government strictly prohibited any unauthorized military overflight across its northern border.
examples.zh: 政府严禁任何未经授权的军用飞机飞越其北部边境上空。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overflight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the rounded armor plates at the armpits of a suit of armor

examples.en: The artist carefully arranged vibrant oil paints across his wooden pallette before painting.
examples.zh: 画家在作画前，细心地在木制调色板上排开鲜艳的油画颜料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pallette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dark purple salt of permanganic acid; in water solution it is used as a disinfectant and antiseptic

examples.en: Potassium permanganate is commonly used in laboratories as a powerful chemical oxidizing agent.
examples.zh: 高锰酸钾在实验室中常用作一种强效的化学氧化剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 permanganate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 靠股息生活的人,靠收租生活的人,<贬>食利者
lemmas.def_en: someone whose income is from property rents or bond interest and other investments

examples.en: The idle rentier lived comfortably on monthly dividends without ever working a day.
examples.zh: 这个无所事事的食利者靠每月股息过着舒适的生活，一天工也没打过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rentier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small bottle that contains a drug (especially a sealed sterile container for injection by needle)

examples.en: The alchemist poured a glowing blue liquid from a glass phial into the beaker.
examples.zh: 炼金术士将发光的蓝色液体从小玻璃药瓶倒入烧杯中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a knife with a blade that folds into the handle; suitable for carrying in the pocket

examples.en: He used his trusty pocketknife to slice the apple during the mountain hike.
examples.zh: 在山间徒步时，他用随身携带的小折刀切开了苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pocketknife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: prior to menopause

examples.en: The clinical study focuses on bone density changes in healthy premenopausal adult women.
examples.zh: 这项临床研究重点关注绝经前期健康成年女性的骨密度变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 premenopausal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of cognitive psychology that studies the psychological basis of linguistic competence and performance

examples.en: She decided to study psycholinguistics to understand how human brains process spoken language.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读心理语言学，以了解人类大脑如何处理口头语言。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]心理语言的, 精神语言的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the psychology of language

examples.en: The new study examined psycholinguistic factors influencing how young children acquire second languages.
examples.zh: 这项新研究探讨了影响幼儿习得第二语言的心理语言学因素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psycholinguistics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: power to influence or coerce

examples.en: The medieval monarch demonstrated his royal puissance by commanding a massive loyal army.
examples.zh: 这位中世纪君主通过统领一支庞大忠诚的军队，展现了他的皇权与威势。

lemmas.def_zh: 强有力的, 强盛的, 有权力的
lemmas.def_en: powerful

examples.en: The king faced a puissant rival determined to seize his throne.
examples.zh: 国王面临着一位决心夺取他王位的强大对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puissance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脓的, 化脓性的, 化脓的
lemmas.def_en: containing pus

examples.en: The doctor examined the purulent wound carefully and prescribed a course of antibiotics.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了化脓的伤口，并开了一个疗程的抗生素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purulent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a white crystalline oxide used in the production of calcium hydroxide

examples.en: Workers added water to the dry quicklime to produce slaked lime for construction.
examples.zh: 工人们在干燥的生石灰中加水，以制成用于建筑的熟石灰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quicklime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To conquer and take back territory that was previously lost.

examples.en: The determined general led his troops back to reconquer the lost coastal territory.
examples.zh: 坚定的将军率领部队返回，夺回了失去的沿海领土。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reconquer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可租的, 可收租金的
lemmas.def_en: that is able or fit be rented

examples.en: The real estate agency listed several newly renovated, highly rentable apartments downtown.
examples.zh: 这家房产中介列出了几套位于市中心、刚翻新且极易出租的公寓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rentable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柳树多的, 易弯的, 苗条的, 优雅的
lemmas.def_en: slender and graceful

examples.en: The willowy dancer moved effortlessly across the stage with extraordinary poise and grace.
examples.zh: 那位身材苗条修长的舞者在舞台上轻盈移动，姿态格外优雅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 willowy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贵族, 大官, 显要人物
lemmas.def_en: a person of distinguished rank or appearance

examples.en: The Venetian magnifico hosted lavish evening banquets inside his grand marble palace.
examples.zh: 这位威尼斯显贵在他宏伟的大理石宫殿里举办了奢华的晚宴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magnifico 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tradesman who sells hosiery and (in England) knitwear

examples.en: The traditional local hosier crafted durable wool socks and stockings for winter.
examples.zh: 这位当地的传统织袜商为冬天制作耐穿的羊毛短袜和长筒袜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hosier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅行手提包, 手提箱
lemmas.def_en: a capacious bag or basket

examples.en: She packed her gym clothes and running shoes into a durable canvas holdall.
examples.zh: 她把健身服和跑鞋装进了一个结实的帆布旅行手提包里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holdall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 多介质的, 超媒体
lemmas.def_en: a multimedia system in which related items of information are connected and can be presented together

examples.en: Modern websites effectively utilize hypermedia to combine text, dynamic audio, and interactive video.
examples.zh: 现代网站有效地利用超媒体将文本、动态音频和交互式视频结合起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypermedia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an underground banking system based on trust whereby money can be made available internationally without actually moving it or leaving a record of the transaction

examples.en: Migrant workers often relied on the informal hawala network to send money home.
examples.zh: 外来务工人员过去常常依赖非正规的哈瓦拉网络向家里汇款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hawala 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the presence of blood in the urine; often a symptom of urinary tract disease

examples.en: The patient visited a specialist after noticing visible hematuria during his morning routine.
examples.zh: 患者在早晨发现肉眼可见的血尿后，前往专科医生处就诊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hematuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (meteorology) winds spiraling outward from a high pressure center; circling clockwise in the northern hemisphere and counterclockwise in the southern

examples.en: A powerful winter anticyclone brought clear blue skies and freezing temperatures nationwide.
examples.zh: 一股强烈的冬季反气旋给全国带来了晴朗的天空和极低的严寒气温。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of the atmosphere around a high pressure center

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anticyclone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿坏, 用旧, 耗尽(力气等)
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To last longer or remain usable for a greater time than something else; (archaic) to wear out or exhaust.

examples.en: These sturdy leather boots will easily outwear any cheap modern synthetic running shoes.
examples.zh: 这些结实的皮靴肯定比任何廉价的现代合成跑鞋都要耐穿耐磨。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past participle of outwear; worn out, obsolete, or no longer useful.

examples.en: This material outwears all others

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outwear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 从底层加固, 支持, 加强
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To support, strengthen, or provide the underlying foundation for a belief, system, or structure.

examples.en: Solid empirical data must undergird any theory proposed by the research team.
examples.zh: 坚实的实验数据必须作为研究团队所提出理论的基石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undergird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 算出来, 列举, 读出
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / rare) To count, enumerate, or read out numbers.

examples.en: The clerk took several minutes to numerate all the items on the long list.
examples.zh: 职员花了几分钟才把长清单上的所有项目一一列举出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 计算, 命数法, 数字的读法
lemmas.def_en: naming numbers

family_guide.root_logic: 以 numerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柱顶线盘, 柱上楣构
lemmas.def_en: (architecture) the structure consisting of the part of a classical temple above the columns between a capital and the roof

examples.en: Carved stone figures adorned the classical entablature resting above the marble columns.
examples.zh: 大理石柱顶部的古典柱上楣构饰有雕刻石像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entablature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平衡, 平均, 相称
lemmas.def_en: stabilization by bringing into equilibrium

examples.en: The rapid equilibration of temperature between the two liquids surprised the chemistry students.
examples.zh: 两种液体之间迅速实现的温度平衡让化学系的学生们感到惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equilibration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (有柄的)大口水壶, 花瓶状水罐
lemmas.def_en: an open vessel with a handle and a spout for pouring

examples.en: She poured cool water from an antique silver ewer into the glass.
examples.zh: 她从一个仿古银质大口水壶中倒出凉水注入玻璃杯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ewer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 到难耐的程度, 无法忍受
lemmas.def_en: to an unacceptable degree

examples.en: The crowded train car grew intolerably hot as the air conditioning system failed.
examples.zh: 随着空调系统失效，拥挤的车厢变得热得令人难以忍受。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intolerably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (psychology) an extroverted disposition; concern with what is outside the self

examples.en: His natural extroversion made it very easy for him to network at conferences.
examples.zh: 他天生外向的性格使他在会议上拓展人脉变得十分轻松。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extroversion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a motley assortment of things

examples.en: The documentary was dismissed by critics as a farrago of unverified rumors.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片被评论家斥为一堆未经证实的谣言杂烩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 farrago 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young or small fish

examples.en: Thousands of salmon fingerlings were released into the river to restore the population.
examples.zh: 数千条鲑鱼幼鱼被放流到河中以恢复种群数量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fingerling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 航空母舰, 平顶的建筑
lemmas.def_en: a closely cropped haircut; usually for men

examples.en: The naval fleet was escorted by a massive flattop carrying advanced fighter jets.
examples.zh: 这支海军舰队由一艘搭载先进战机的大型航空母舰护航。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flattop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sharp narrow ridge found in rugged mountains

examples.en: The climbers carefully navigated the sharp arete under extremely strong mountain winds.
examples.zh: 登山者们在极其强烈的山风中小心地穿过陡峭险峻的山脊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arete 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The patient was promptly admitted to the hospital after being diagnosed with encephalomyelitis.
examples.zh: 该患者在被确诊患有脑脊髓炎后被立即收治入院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encephalomyelitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known

examples.en: Clear all that useless electronic gubbins off the desk so we can work.
examples.zh: 把桌上那些没用的小杂物都清理掉，我们好开始干活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gubbins 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several trees or shrubs of the genus Carpinus

examples.en: The dense hedge of hornbeam provided complete privacy for the quiet garden patio.
examples.zh: 茂密的鹅耳枥树篱为幽静的花园露台提供了完全的私密性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hornbeam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chop cut from a hog

examples.en: He ordered a grilled porkchop served with mashed potatoes and seasoned greens.
examples.zh: 他点了一份配有土豆泥和调味蔬菜的烤猪排。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porkchop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同音异义字, 同名异物
lemmas.def_en: two words are homonyms if they are pronounced or spelled the same way but have different meanings

examples.en: The words 'bark' of a dog and tree 'bark' serve as a common homonym.
examples.zh: 狗叫的“bark”与树皮的“bark”是常见的同形同音异义词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homonym 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the Babylonian goddess of healing and consort of Ninurta

examples.en: The entomologist examined the insect's gula carefully under a powerful desktop microscope.
examples.zh: 昆虫学家在高倍台式显微镜下仔细观察了该昆虫的下咽区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gula 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small spiny-finned fish of coastal or brackish waters having a large head and elongated tapering body having the ventral fins modified as a sucker

examples.en: The dishonest salesman easily found a gudgeon willing to buy the broken appliance.
examples.zh: 那个不诚实的推销员很容易就找到一个愿意买下破损电器的冤大头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gudgeon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an olive-green sandstone containing glauconite

examples.en: Organic gardeners often add greensand to their soil to supply essential potassium.
examples.zh: 有机园艺师经常在土壤中添加绿砂以补充必需的钾元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greensand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a digital computer of medium size

examples.en: Decades ago, the university purchased an expensive minicomputer to handle academic data.
examples.zh: 几十年前，该大学购买了一台昂贵的小型计算机来处理学术数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minicomputer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (in India and Malaysia) a warehouse

examples.en: Workers unloaded dozens of wooden crates into the damp dockside godown yesterday.
examples.zh: 工人们昨天将几十个木箱卸到了码头边潮湿的仓库里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 godown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 西班牙的绞刑具, 上述绞刑
lemmas.def_en: an instrument of execution for execution by strangulation

examples.en: The medieval assassin carried a concealed wire garrote beneath his heavy wool cloak.
examples.zh: 那个中世纪刺客在他厚重的羊毛斗篷下藏了一根绞刑金属丝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 garrote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blowfish highly prized as a delicacy in Japan but highly dangerous because the skin and organs are poisonous

examples.en: Only licensed chefs are legally permitted to prepare dangerous fugu in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本，只有持有执照的厨师才被法律允许烹饪危险的河豚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fugu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal term of address for someone's wife

examples.en: He told his coworkers that the missis wanted him home early tonight.
examples.zh: 他告诉同事们，家里太太今晚想让他早点回家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 missis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 受霜害的, 生冻疮的
lemmas.def_en: injured by freezing or partial freezing

examples.en: The mountaineer wore thick gloves to protect his frostbitten fingers from further cold damage.
examples.zh: 这名登山者戴着厚手套，以保护冻伤的手指免受进一步的寒气伤害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frostbitten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无教养的, 粗俗的, 不雅的
lemmas.def_en: in violation of good taste even verging on the indecent

examples.en: Asking about her salary in front of everyone was considered rather indelicate.
examples.zh: 当着大家的面打听她的薪水被认为相当不礼貌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indelicate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 音位转换, 转移, 置换
lemmas.def_en: a linguistic process of transposition of sounds or syllables within a word or words within a sentence

examples.en: The word ask developed from an earlier form through a linguistic process called metathesis.
examples.zh: 单词ask是由早期形式通过被称为音位转换的语言过程演变而来的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metathesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: common jay of eastern North America; bright blue with grey breast

examples.en: A loud jaybird perched in the oak tree, disturbing the quiet morning.
examples.zh: 一只吵闹的松鸦停在橡树上，打破了清晨的宁静。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jaybird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麦斯卡尔酒, 龙舌兰, 威廉斯仙人球
lemmas.def_en: a small spineless globe-shaped cactus; source of mescal buttons

examples.en: They enjoyed a sip of smoky mescal while sitting around the desert campfire.
examples.zh: 他们围坐在沙漠营火旁，小酌了一口带着烟熏味的麦斯卡尔酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mescal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the cornea causing watery painful eyes and blurred vision

examples.en: Wearing dirty contact lenses for long periods can cause painful corneal keratitis.
examples.zh: 长期佩戴不干净的隐形眼镜会导致痛苦的角膜炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keratitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of any of various apple trees of the genus Malus

examples.en: The chef smoked the pork ribs over aromatic applewood for several hours.
examples.zh: 厨师用芳香的苹果木将猪肋排熏制了数小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 applewood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: human-centered

examples.en: Traditional philosophy often holds an anthropocentric view that places humans above nature.
examples.zh: 传统哲学往往持有一种将人类置于自然之中的人类中心主义观点。

lemmas.def_zh: 人类中心说, 人类本位说
lemmas.def_en: an inclination to evaluate reality exclusively in terms of human values

examples.en: Deep ecology challenges anthropocentrism by asserting that all living species have intrinsic value.
examples.zh: 深层生态学主张所有生物都拥有内在价值，以此质疑人类中心主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthropocentric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: migrating from the sea to fresh water to spawn

examples.en: Salmon are anadromous fish that migrate from the sea into rivers to spawn.
examples.zh: 鲑鱼是一种从海洋洄游到河流中产卵的溯河产卵鱼类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anadromous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (meteorology) the horizontal transfer of heat or other atmospheric properties

examples.en: Coastal fog rolled into the valley through the steady advection of moist marine air.
examples.zh: 沿海的雾气随着潮湿海洋空气的稳定平流涌入了山谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 advection 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a nutritive starch obtained from the root of the arrowroot plant

examples.en: She used powdered arrowroot as a natural thickening agent for the fruit sauce.
examples.zh: 她用竹芋粉作为果酱的天然增稠剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arrowroot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 删节, 删节本, 缩短, 限制
lemmas.def_en: a shortened version of a written work

examples.en: Students often read a concise abridgment of the lengthy classic novel for class.
examples.zh: 学生们上课常读这部冗长经典小说的简短删节本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abridgment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various diseases of animals characterized by edema of the head and neck

examples.en: Winning the local championship gave the young striker an annoying bighead.
examples.zh: 赢得当地锦标赛让这名年轻前锋滋生了令人讨厌的自大心理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bighead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [美国英语]；活动中心之外的对方
lemmas.def_en: the piece of ground in the outfield on the catcher's left

examples.en: The sudden resignation of the CEO seemed to come completely out of leftfield.
examples.zh: 首席执行官的突然辞职似乎完全出乎所有人的意料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leftfield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: European twining plant whose flowers are used chiefly to flavor malt liquors; cultivated in America

examples.en: The hop bine climbed gracefully up the tall wooden trellis in the yard.
examples.zh: 啤酒花藤蔓优雅地沿着院子里高高的木格架向上攀爬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: yellow carotenoid pigments in plants and animal fats and egg yolks

examples.en: Eating dark leafy greens provides lutein, which is beneficial for eye health.
examples.zh: 食用深色绿叶蔬菜可以补充叶黄素，有益于眼睛健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lutein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood from the hard woody root of the briar Erica arborea; used to make tobacco pipes

examples.en: He carefully carved a classic smoking pipe from a solid block of briarwood.
examples.zh: 他用一整块坚硬的石楠木精心雕刻了一只经典的烟斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 briarwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对...吹胡子瞪眼睛, 吓唬
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ into) To intimidate or bully someone into doing something using harsh words or stern looks.

examples.en: The defense attorney tried to browbeat the nervous witness into changing her testimony.
examples.zh: 辩护律师试图恐吓这名紧张的证人以迫使其改变证词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 browbeat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flammable alcohol derived from butanes and used for solvents

examples.en: Researchers are investigating butanol as a promising alternative fuel for modern combustion engines.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在调查丁醇作为现代内燃机有前景的替代燃料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butanol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 补充, 是...的补充物, 补足
lemmas.def_en: the grammatical relation of a word or phrase to a predicate

examples.en: The design achieved perfect balance through the mutual complementation of light and shadow.
examples.zh: 该设计通过光与影的相互补充实现了完美的平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 complementation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to the same species

examples.en: Male birds often display vibrant plumage to attract conspecific females during mating season.
examples.zh: 雄鸟在繁殖季节通常会展示鲜艳的羽毛来吸引同种雌鸟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conspecific 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a skirt stiffened with hoops

examples.en: The Victorian gown was supported by a wide crinoline made of steel hoops.
examples.zh: 这件维多利亚时代的礼服由钢圈制成的宽大裙衬撑起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crinoline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the seats in the House of Commons used by members who do not vote regularly with either the government or the Opposition

examples.en: Several independent members sat on the crossbench, holding the balance of power.
examples.zh: 几位独立议员坐在中立议席上，掌握着权力的平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crossbench 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: breed of sled dog developed in Alaska

examples.en: The Alaskan malamute pulled the heavy sled effortlessly across the snowy trail.
examples.zh: 阿拉斯加雪橇犬轻松地拉着沉重的雪橇穿过被积雪覆盖的小道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malamute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute wingless psocopterous insects injurious to books and papers

examples.en: The family kept a solemn deathwatch by the old man's bedside throughout the night.
examples.zh: 整整一夜，家人都在老人的床边肃穆地进行临终看护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deathwatch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a calcareous material harder and denser than bone that comprises the bulk of a tooth

examples.en: Enamel protects the softer dentine underneath from decay and everyday wear.
examples.zh: 牙釉质保护其下方较软的牙质免受蛀蚀和日常磨损。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dentine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being diagnosed

examples.en: The mechanic confirmed that the car's engine fault was easily diagnosable.
examples.zh: 技工证实这辆车的发动机故障很容易诊断出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diagnosable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: heartily or earnestly

examples.en: The two candidates went at it dingdong throughout the entire debate.
examples.zh: 两位候选人在整场辩论中激烈地争辩不休。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dingdong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a huge quadrupedal herbivore with long neck and tail; of late Jurassic in western North America

examples.en: The museum features a massive skeleton of a diplodocus near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 博物馆主入口附近陈列着一具巨大的梁龙骨架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diplodocus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lack of proportion; imbalance among the parts of something

examples.en: There is a clear disproportion between the workload and the salary offered.
examples.zh: 工作负荷与所提供的薪水之间存在明显的不均衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disproportion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 垂头丧气的, 无精打采的, 沮丧的
lemmas.def_en: filled with melancholy and despondency

examples.en: Do not feel downhearted just because your first job application was rejected.
examples.zh: 不要仅因为第一份求职申请被拒就感到垂头丧气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downhearted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a downward slope or bend

examples.en: The heavy cart began to roll rapidly along the steep grassy downslope.
examples.zh: 沉重的手推车开始沿着陡峭的长草下坡迅速下滑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downslope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 充分, 完全, 丰富, 大量, 充足
lemmas.def_en: a full supply

examples.en: The autumn harvest brought a rich plenitude of fresh fruits and vegetables.
examples.zh: 秋收带来了极为丰富的大量新鲜水果和蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plenitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bird of tropical Africa and Asia having a very large bill surmounted by a bony protuberance; related to kingfishers

examples.en: A colorful hornbill perched quietly on the highest branch of the rainforest tree.
examples.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的犀鸟静静地栖息在雨林树木的最高枝头上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hornbill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: completely neat and clean

examples.en: After hours of deep cleaning, the entire apartment was spick and span.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的深度清洁，整套公寓变得一尘不染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a band or bracelet worn around the wrist

examples.en: She wore a knitted wristlet to keep her hands warm while typing.
examples.zh: 她戴着一只针织腕套，以便打字时保持手部温暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wristlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏女人, 女恶棍, 女的反派角色
lemmas.def_en: a woman villain

examples.en: The actress played the cunning villainess with remarkable charisma and dark charm.
examples.zh: 这位女演员以非凡的魅力诠释了这个狡黠的女反派角色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 villainess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of muscle tissue

examples.en: He consulted a specialist after experiencing severe muscle pain caused by acute myositis.
examples.zh: 在遭遇急性肌炎引起的严重肌肉疼痛后，他咨询了专家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myositis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large carnivorous bipedal dinosaur having enormous teeth with knifelike serrations; may have been a scavenger rather than an active predator; later Cretaceous period in North America

examples.en: Fossil evidence shows that the tyrannosaur was a dominant apex predator in prehistory.
examples.zh: 化石证据表明，暴龙在史前时期是一种占主导地位的顶级掠食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tyrannosaur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something added by overprinting

examples.en: The rare postal stamp features a red overprint commemorating the historic event.
examples.zh: 这枚珍稀邮票上带有纪念该历史事件的红色加盖文字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overprint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剧团的团员, 有经验的演员, 老演员
lemmas.def_en: a person who is reliable and uncomplaining and hard working

examples.en: Despite having a fever, the seasoned trouper delivered a flawless stage performance.
examples.zh: 尽管发着高烧，这位老演员依然奉献了无可挑剔的舞台表演。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trouper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the contractile organs of the body

examples.en: The medical textbook clearly outlines the structure of the musculus biceps brachii.
examples.zh: 这本医学教科书清晰地勾勒了肱二头肌的结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 musculus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可换位的, 有换位可能的
lemmas.def_en: capable of changing sequence

examples.en: The researcher studied how transposable elements move within the host plant's genome.
examples.zh: 研究人员探究了可换位元件如何在宿主植物的基因组中移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transposable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dramatic composition involving elements of both tragedy and comedy usually with the tragic predominating

examples.en: The movie is a brilliant tragicomedy that balances heartbreak with sharp wit.
examples.zh: 这部电影是一部出色的悲喜剧，兼顾了心碎与敏锐的幽默。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲喜剧的, 又悲又喜的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of tragicomedy

examples.en: The novel offered a tragicomic view of family life during the great economic crisis.
examples.zh: 这部小说以一种悲喜交加的视角展现了经济大危机期间的家庭生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tragicomedy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (botany) main root of a plant growing straight downward from the stem

examples.en: Dandelions develop a strong taproot that makes them difficult to pull out completely.
examples.zh: 蒲公英会生出粗壮的主根，这使得它们很难被彻底拔除。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taproot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pen for swine

examples.en: The mother told her son to clean his bedroom because it resembled a pigsty.
examples.zh: 母亲让儿子打扫卧室，因为那里脏得简直像个猪舍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pigsty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the pericardium

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with pericarditis after detecting inflammation around the heart.
examples.zh: 在检测出心脏周围有炎症后，医生诊断该患者患有心包炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pericarditis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有...层楼的, 分层的, 迭生的
lemmas.def_en: having stories as indicated

examples.en: The historic square is surrounded by ancient, multi-storeyed brick houses.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的广场周围环绕着古老的多层砖石房屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 storeyed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to fish

examples.en: The marine biologist dedicated her entire career to studying diverse piscine species.
examples.zh: 这位海洋生物学家毕生致力于研究各种鱼类物种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piscine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有资格领退休金等的, 可领退休金等的
lemmas.def_en: entitled to receive a pension

examples.en: Employees must reach the pensionable age before they can claim full benefits.
examples.zh: 员工必须达到可领养老金的年龄才能申领全额福利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pensionable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a surface of hardened plaster (as on a wall or ceiling)
