examples.en: Restorers carefully repaired the ornate plasterwork on the historic ballroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 修复人员仔细修补了历史悠久的宴会厅天花板上华丽的灰泥粉刷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plasterwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the prostate gland characterized by perineal pain and irregular urination and (if severe) chills and fever

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the painful symptoms of chronic prostatitis.
examples.zh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗慢性前列腺炎引起的疼痛症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prostatitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the family Portulacaceae having fleshy succulent obovate leaves often grown as a potherb or salad herb; a weed in some areas

examples.en: Fresh purslane was tossed into the summer salad to add a tangy flavor.
examples.zh: 新鲜的马齿苋被拌入夏季沙拉中，增添了一抹微酸的风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purslane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝向（即麦加天房克尔白所在的方向, 为穆斯林朝拜方向）
lemmas.def_en: the direction of the Kaaba toward which Muslims turn for their daily prayers

examples.en: The hotel room featured a small arrow on the ceiling indicating the qibla.
examples.zh: 酒店房间的天花板上有一个指示朝向的小箭头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 qibla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person with a prejudiced belief that one race is superior to others

examples.en: The candidate was widely condemned for expressing dangerous racialist views during the debate.
examples.zh: 该候选人因在辩论中发表危险的种族主义观点而受到广泛谴责。

lemmas.def_zh: 种族主义, 人种优劣论
lemmas.def_en: discriminatory or abusive behavior towards members of another race

examples.en: The new legislation aimed to eliminate lingering racialism within the judicial system.
examples.zh: 这项新法规旨在消除司法系统内挥之不去的种族主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 racialist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圣职买卖, 圣职买卖罪
lemmas.def_en: traffic in ecclesiastical offices or preferments

examples.en: In the Middle Ages, the corrupt bishop was accused of practicing simony.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，那位堕落的主教被指控犯有买卖圣职罪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一印度菜色：黄瓜优酪乳/酸奶沙拉
lemmas.def_en: an Indian side dish of yogurt and chopped cucumbers and spices

examples.en: The spicy chicken curry was served with cool cucumber raita on the side.
examples.zh: 辛辣的咖喱鸡配有一份清凉的黄瓜酸奶沙拉作为解辣小菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raita 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a simple type of jet engine; must be launched at high speed

examples.en: The experimental missile was powered by an advanced supersonic ramjet engine.
examples.zh: 这枚实验性导弹由先进的超音速冲压发动机提供动力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramjet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a grey lustrous metallic element of the rare earth group; is used in special alloys; occurs in monazite and bastnasite

examples.en: Samarium is a rare earth element commonly used to create strong permanent magnets.
examples.zh: 钐是一种常用于制造强力永磁体的稀土元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 samarium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an underwater mountain rising above the ocean floor

examples.en: Scientists discovered a unique marine ecosystem thriving around the dormant underwater seamount.
examples.zh: 科学家在这座休眠的水下海山周围发现了繁盛的独特海洋生态系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seamount 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 个体发生, 个体发生学
lemmas.def_en: (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level

examples.en: The research paper examines the morphological changes during the ontogeny of amphibians.
examples.zh: 该研究论文探讨了两栖动物个体发育过程中的形态变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 个体发生的, 个体发育的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the origin and development of individual organisms

examples.en: Scientists observed the ontogenetic changes in the frog as it developed from a tadpole.
examples.zh: 科学家观察了青蛙从蝌蚪发育过程中所发生的个体发育变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ontogeny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (medicine) To make a person or animal calm, sleepy, or unconscious by giving a sedative drug.

examples.en: Park rangers had to tranquilize the escaped bear to transport it safely.
examples.zh: 公园护林员不得不给逃跑的熊注射镇静剂以便安全转移它。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tranquilize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the colon or rectum or anus

examples.en: He consulted a specialist in proctology to address his persistent digestive issues.
examples.zh: 他咨询了直肠病学专家，以解决持续存在的肠道问题。

lemmas.def_en: a doctor specializing in diseases of the rectum and anus

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proctology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or resembling lymphatic glands or lymphoid tissue

examples.en: The surgeon recommended removing the enlarged adenoid tissue to ease his breathing.
examples.zh: 外科医生建议切除增大的腺样体组织以改善他的呼吸。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the adenoids

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adenoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a speaker with an unusually loud voice

examples.en: His voice boomed across the crowded hall like that of a stentor.
examples.zh: 他的声音像个洪亮的大嗓门一样在拥挤的大厅里回荡。

lemmas.def_en: used of the voice

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stentor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of flowers) having petals

examples.en: The delicate five-petaled white flowers bloomed early in the spring garden.
examples.zh: 娇嫩的五瓣白花在初春的花园里竞相绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petaled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill

examples.en: Modern didactics emphasizes student participation over traditional rote memorization.
examples.zh: 现代教学法强调学生的参与，而非传统的死记硬背。

lemmas.def_zh: 教导(性), 说教(性), 教诲(性)
lemmas.def_en: communication that is suitable for or intended to be instructive

examples.en: Critics disliked the novel because its overwhelming didacticism overshadowed the plot.
examples.zh: 评论家们不喜欢这部小说，因为其浓厚的说教意味掩盖了情节。

lemmas.def_en: in a didactic manner

examples.en: this is a didactically sound method

lemmas.def_zh: 教训的, 说教的, 教导的, 教诲的
lemmas.def_en: instructive (especially excessively)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 didactics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把(某人或某物)抛出窗外
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / historical) To throw someone or something out of a window; (informal) to dismiss a leader abruptly.

examples.en: The angry mob threatened to defenestrate the corrupt officials from the city hall.
examples.zh: 愤怒的暴民威胁要将那些腐败官员从市政厅的窗户扔出去。

lemmas.def_en: the act of throwing someone or something out of a window

family_guide.root_logic: 以 defenestrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 归属的, 属性的, 定语的
lemmas.def_en: of adjectives; placed before the nouns they modify

examples.en: In the phrase 'red apple,' the word 'red' is in an attributive position.
examples.zh: 在短语“红苹果”中，“红”字处于定语位置。

lemmas.def_en: in an attributive manner

examples.en: the genitive noun is used attributively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attributive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with little or no preparation or forethought

examples.en: She regretted making an offhanded remark that unintentionally hurt her friend's feelings.
examples.zh: 她很后悔自己随口说了句漫不经心的话，无意中伤害了朋友的感情。

lemmas.def_zh: 立即地; 即席地; 未经准备地; 不客气地
lemmas.def_en: without previous thought or preparation

examples.en: couldn't give the figures offhand
we decided offhand to go to Canada

family_guide.root_logic: 以 offhanded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or containing clay

examples.en: The gardeners struggled to dig through the heavy clayey soil after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后，园丁们费力地挖掘着沉重黏腻的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clayey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a margin or fringe of hairlike projections

examples.en: The microscope clearly revealed the ciliated cells lining the respiratory tract.
examples.zh: 显微镜清晰地显示出呼吸道表面的纤毛细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ciliated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: civilian garb as opposed to a military uniform

examples.en: After leaving the army, he felt strange wearing civvies every day.
examples.zh: 退伍后，他每天穿便服感觉有些不习惯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 civvies 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several small trout-like fish of the genus Salvelinus

examples.en: The cold mountain lake is famous for its abundant population of Arctic charr.
examples.zh: 这座寒冷的高山湖泊以盛产北极红点鲑而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charr 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 历经时间长河的, 历时的
lemmas.def_en: used of the study of a phenomenon (especially language) as it changes through time

examples.en: The professor conducted a diachronic study of vowel changes in the English language.
examples.zh: 教授对英语元音的历史演变进行了历时性研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diachronic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone whose occupation is making or repairing clocks and watches

examples.en: The skilled clockmaker carefully cleaned the delicate gears of the antique timepiece.
examples.zh: 技术精湛的钟表匠仔细清理了古董表内部精密的齿轮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clockmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谈话, 会话, 讨论
lemmas.def_en: a conversation especially a formal one

examples.en: The delegates held a private colloquy to discuss the terms of the treaty.
examples.zh: 代表们举行了一场私人会谈，讨论条约的各项条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colloquy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having male and female reproductive organs in separate plants or animals

examples.en: Ginkgo trees are dioecious, meaning individual trees produce either male or female flowers.
examples.zh: 银杏树是雌雄异株的，这意味着单株植株只开雄花或雌花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dioecious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of sideboard or buffet

examples.en: She placed the antique porcelain vases neatly on top of the wooden credenza.
examples.zh: 她把那些古董瓷瓶整齐地摆放在木制餐具柜上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 credenza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bluish discoloration of the skin and mucous membranes; a sign that oxygen in the blood is dangerously diminished (as in carbon monoxide poisoning)

examples.en: The patient exhibited severe cyanosis around his lips due to a lack of oxygen.
examples.zh: 由于缺氧，该患者的嘴唇周围出现了严重的发绀症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cyanosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of biology that studies the cellular aspects of heredity (especially the chromosomes)

examples.en: Advances in cytogenetics have helped scientists identify the chromosomal causes of certain diseases.
examples.zh: 细胞遗传学的进步帮助科学家确定了某些疾病的染色体诱因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytogenetics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: aromatic annual Old World herb cultivated for its finely divided and often curly leaves for use especially in soups and salads

examples.en: The chef garnished the creamy potato soup with freshly chopped chervil.
examples.zh: 主厨在浓郁的土豆汤上撒上了新鲜切碎的雪维菜作点缀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chervil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 候见室, 前厅, 休息室
lemmas.def_en: a large entrance or reception room or area

examples.en: Several anxious applicants waited in the quiet anteroom before their job interviews.
examples.zh: 几位焦虑的应聘者在安静的候见室里等待面试。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anteroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flat pancake-like bread cooked on a griddle

examples.en: We tore off pieces of warm chapati to scoop up the spicy vegetable curry.
examples.zh: 我们撕下一块块热乎乎的印度薄饼，用来蘸辛辣的蔬菜咖喱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chapati 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mark used by an author or editor to indicate where something is to be inserted into a text

examples.en: The editor inserted a caret to indicate where the missing word belonged.
examples.zh: 编辑插入了一个脱字符，以指示遗漏单词应补入的位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caret 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a formative one-cell layer of tissue between xylem and phloem in most vascular plants that is responsible for secondary growth

examples.en: Damage to the tree's cambium can prevent vital nutrients from flowing properly.
examples.zh: 损坏树木的形成层会阻碍重要营养物质的正常流动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cambium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy wooden pole (such as the trunk of a young fir) that is tossed as a test of strength (in the Highlands of northern Scotland)

examples.en: The Scottish athlete gathered his strength and tossed the heavy caber end over end.
examples.zh: 这位苏格兰运动员积蓄力量，将沉重的长木桩头尾翻转着掷出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 夜莺, 歌手, 诗人
lemmas.def_en: nightingale spoken of in Persian poetry

examples.en: A cheerful bulbul perched on the garden branch, singing a sweet melodic tune.
examples.zh: 一只欢快的鹎鸟停在花园的枝头，唱着甜美悠扬的曲调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bulbul 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一群, 一组, 贿赂
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: Corrupt officials stashed the stolen boodle in secret offshore bank accounts.
examples.zh: 腐败官员将非法收受的大笔赃款藏匿在秘密的离岸银行账户中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boodle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 矢车菊, 蓝色扁平帽, 苏格兰人
lemmas.def_en: low-growing annual herb of southwestern United States (Texas) having silky foliage and blue flowers; a leading cause of livestock poisoning in the southwestern United States

examples.en: Every spring, rolling hills across the countryside are covered in vibrant bluebonnet blossoms.
examples.zh: 每年春天，乡间起伏的山丘上都开满了鲜艳的矢车菊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluebonnet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or being biography

examples.en: The documentary provides fascinating biographic details about the famous author's early life.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片提供了关于这位著名作家早年生活的迷人传记细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biographic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a furnished sitting room with sleeping accommodations (and some plumbing)

examples.en: As a university student, he lived in a modest bedsit near campus.
examples.zh: 上大学时，他住在学校附近一间简陋的单室公寓里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedsit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an etching made by a process that makes it resemble a water color

examples.en: The artist used the aquatint technique to create rich, textured tones in the print.
examples.zh: 艺术家采用飞尘腐蚀版画技法，在印张上营造出丰富而有质感的色调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aquatint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: blood serum containing antibodies against specific antigens; provides immunity to a disease

examples.en: The clinic quickly administered snake antiserum to the victim to neutralize the venom.
examples.zh: 诊所迅速为伤者注射了抗蛇毒血清以中和毒性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiserum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the inner germ layer that develops into the lining of the digestive and respiratory systems

examples.en: During embryonic development, the inner layer called the endoderm forms the digestive tract.
examples.zh: 在胚胎发育过程中，被称为内胚层的内层组织会形成消化道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endoderm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]还原成形术的,整形术的,退行发育术的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to anaplasia

examples.en: The pathologist confirmed that the tumor had anaplastic features, indicating an aggressive form of cancer.
examples.zh: 病理学家证实该肿瘤具有未分化退行发育特征，表明这是一种侵袭性癌症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anaplastic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向舞台前方的, 前台的
lemmas.def_en: of the front half of a stage

examples.en: The lead actor slowly moved to the downstage edge to deliver his final monologue.
examples.zh: 主角缓缓走向舞台前缘，念出他的最后一段独白。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downstage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (贬)乡巴佬, 土包子, 乡下佬
lemmas.def_en: a person who is not very intelligent or interested in culture

examples.en: City slickers often mocked him as a country yokel, ignoring his sharp practical intelligence.
examples.zh: 城里人常嘲笑他是乡巴佬，却忽视了他精明的实用智慧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yokel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 考试, 批判性的研究, 良心反省
lemmas.def_en: a detailed inspection of your conscience (as done daily by Jesuits)

examples.en: Before going to sleep, she practiced an evening examen to reflect on her daily actions.
examples.zh: 睡前，她进行了良心反省，以审视自己一天的所作所为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 examen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lighted only by stars

examples.en: They enjoyed a quiet midnight walk along the beach under a clear starlit sky.
examples.zh: 他们在晴朗的星空下，沿着海滩享受宁静的午夜漫步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starlit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: either of two muscles of the abdomen and pelvis that flex the trunk and rotate the thigh

examples.en: Sitting for long hours at a desk can tighten your psoas and cause back pain.
examples.zh: 长时间伏案久坐会使腰肌紧绷，从而引起背部疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psoas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: plantain of Mediterranean regions whose seeds swell and become gelatinous when moist and are used as a mild laxative

examples.en: Adding a spoonful of psyllium husk to your morning smoothie helps promote healthy digestion.
examples.zh: 在早晨的冰沙中加入一勺欧车前壳有助于促进消化健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psyllium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 份量充足的, 纯良的
lemmas.def_en: absolutely first class and genuine

examples.en: He finally earned a pukka contract with the firm after months of temporary work.
examples.zh: 经过数月的临时工作，他终于与该事务所签订了一份正规合同。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pukka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 十[十三]行诗, 回旋诗
lemmas.def_en: a musical form that is often the last movement of a sonata

examples.en: The poet carefully structured his romantic verse according to the classical French rondeau form.
examples.zh: 诗人严格按照法国古典回旋诗的形式构建了他浪漫的诗篇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rondeau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coarse, indigestible plant food low in nutrients; its bulk stimulates intestinal peristalsis

examples.en: Nutritionists recommend eating leafy vegetables to ensure you get enough dietary roughage every day.
examples.zh: 营养学家建议多吃绿叶蔬菜，以确保每天摄入足够的膳食粗纤维。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roughage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very large herbivorous dinosaur of the Jurassic and Cretaceous having a small head a long neck and tail and five-toed limbs; largest known land animal

examples.en: The museum unveiled the complete skeleton of a gigantic sauropod discovered in the desert.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了在沙漠中发现的巨型蜥脚类恐龙的完整骨架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sauropod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙的, 多痂的, 难解决的, 猥亵的
lemmas.def_en: rough to the touch; covered with scales or scurf

examples.en: The biographer refused to dwell on the scabrous details of the politician's scandalous private life.
examples.zh: 传记作者拒绝详述那位政客丑陋私生活中粗俗下流的细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scabrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全相同的, 同一的
lemmas.def_en: being the exact same one; not any other:

examples.en: Twenty years later, she found herself standing in the selfsame room where she grew up.
examples.zh: 二十年后，她发现自己站在了当年抚养她长大的同一间屋子里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 selfsame 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very large white gannet with black wing tips

examples.en: A lone solan dove straight into the ocean waters to catch fish near the cliffs.
examples.zh: 一只塘鹅径直潜入悬崖附近的海水中捕鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 焦虑, 关心, 担心, 挂念, 渴望, 担心的事情
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of excessive concern

examples.en: The nurse showed deep solicitude toward the elderly patient throughout his long recovery period.
examples.zh: 在漫长的康复期中，护士对这位老年患者表现出了深切的关怀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solicitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Veronica

examples.en: Tiny blue speedwell flowers began to bloom across the lawn as early spring arrived.
examples.zh: 初春来临，草坪上各处都绽放出了细小的蓝色婆婆纳花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speedwell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or composed of fat

examples.en: Manufacturers often use stearic acid as a hardening agent in candle and soap production.
examples.zh: 制造商经常在蜡烛和肥皂生产中使用硬脂酸作为硬化剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stearic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波兰式围裙, 波洛奈兹舞
lemmas.def_en: a woman's dress with a tight bodice and an overskirt drawn back to reveal a colorful underskirt

examples.en: The grand anniversary ball commenced with a traditional polonaise danced by the royal guests.
examples.zh: 盛大的周年舞会由王室宾客跳起的传统波洛奈兹舞拉开序幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polonaise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heading of a subdivision of a text

examples.en: You should add a descriptive subheading to make this long chapter easier to navigate.
examples.zh: 你应该添加一个描述性的副标题，以使这个长篇章节更易于阅读。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subheading 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [中]大班(旧中国洋行老板),澳大利亚北部产的一种毒蛇
lemmas.def_en: large highly venomous snake of northeastern Australia

examples.en: The coastal taipan is notorious as one of the most venomous snakes in the world.
examples.zh: 海岸太攀蛇作为世界上毒性最强的蛇类之一而臭名昭著。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taipan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long-tailed arboreal mustelid of Central America and South America

examples.en: A solitary taira scurried through the tropical rainforest canopy in search of ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 一只落单的狐鼬穿梭在热带雨林的树冠间寻找成熟的水果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taira 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新来者, 新手, 生手, 无经验者
lemmas.def_en: an inexperienced person (especially someone inexperienced in outdoor living)

examples.en: The experienced mountain guide had little patience for any tenderfoot complaining about blistered feet.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的登山向导对那些抱怨脚上起水泡的新手毫无耐心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenderfoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (尤指被看作神一般的宗教领袖的)日本国天皇
lemmas.def_en: the emperor of Japan; when regarded as a religious leader the emperor is called tenno

examples.en: The imperial decree was issued under the direct authority of the reigning Tenno of Japan.
examples.zh: 该帝国法令是在当朝日本天皇的直接权威下颁布的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of thermions

examples.en: Early radios relied on thermionic valves to amplify weak electrical signals.
examples.zh: 早期的无线电依靠热离子管来放大微弱的电信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thermionic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a leader in a campaign or movement

examples.en: She was hailed as a torchbearer for human rights and democracy.
examples.zh: 她被誉为人权与民主的启蒙者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 torchbearer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any mammal with prominent tusks (especially an elephant or wild boar)

examples.en: The majestic tusker led his herd slowly across the dry riverbed.
examples.zh: 那头雄伟的长牙大象领着象群缓缓穿过干涸的河床。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tusker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未失去光泽的; 未受玷污的
lemmas.def_en: (of reputation) free from blemishes

examples.en: Despite political controversies, his personal reputation remained entirely untarnished.
examples.zh: 尽管政治争议不断，他个人的声誉依然未受任何玷污。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 untarnished 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a deformity in which there is an abnormal displacement of part of a limb away from the midline of the body

examples.en: The physical therapist noted severe hallux valgus on the patient's right foot.
examples.zh: 物理治疗师注意到患者右脚有严重的拇外翻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 valgus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a crystalline compound found in vanilla beans and some balsam resins; used in perfumes and flavorings

examples.en: Natural vanilla extract contains aromatic vanillin along with many other compounds.
examples.zh: 天然香草提取物含有芳香的香草醛以及许多其他化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vanillin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: elevated open grassland in southern Africa

examples.en: Zebras and antelopes grazed peacefully across the vast open veldt.
examples.zh: 斑马和羚羊在广阔开放的草原上平静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veldt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who buys

examples.en: The contract protects the vendee if the property has hidden structural defects.
examples.zh: 如果房产存在隐蔽的结构缺陷，合同将保护买方权益。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vendee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of geology that studies volcanoes

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research in volcanology helped scientists predict major eruptions.
examples.zh: 她在火山学领域的开创性研究帮助科学家预测重大喷发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 volcanology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: senseless talk

examples.en: The professor dismissed the popular conspiracy theory as complete poppycock.
examples.zh: 教授将那个流行的阴谋论斥为一派胡言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poppycock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小行星, 类行星的物体
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous small celestial bodies that move around the sun

examples.en: Astronomers used the space telescope to track the newly discovered rocky planetoid.
examples.zh: 天文学家使用太空望远镜追踪这颗新发现的多石小行星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 planetoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 慷慨的赠与/赐与, 赏赐物, 慷慨, 大度, 施舍
lemmas.def_en: a gift or money given (as for service or out of benevolence); usually given ostentatiously

examples.en: The local hospital expanded its facilities thanks to the billionaire's largess.
examples.zh: 多亏了这位亿万富翁的慷慨捐赠，当地医院扩建了设施。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 largess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument consisting of a set of graduated metal bars mounted on a frame and played with small hammers

examples.en: She played a delicate melody on the glockenspiel during the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会上，她用钟琴演奏了一段优美细腻的旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glockenspiel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人心碎的, 悲惨的
lemmas.def_en: causing or marked by grief or anguish

examples.en: The film tells a heartrending story of families separated by war.
examples.zh: 这部电影讲述了战争使家庭流离失所的悲惨故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartrending 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the line formed by the lower edge of a skirt or coat

examples.en: Fashion trends this season favor a much lower and elegant skirt hemline.
examples.zh: 本季的时尚潮流偏爱更低、更优雅的裙摆底边。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to the peerage

examples.en: Despite being a highborn lady, she dedicated her life to helping the poor.
examples.zh: 尽管出身名门，这位女士仍毕生致力于帮助穷人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highborn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or located near a hilum

examples.en: The scan revealed an unusual enlargement of the patient's hilar lymph nodes.
examples.zh: 扫描显示该患者的肺门淋巴结有异常肿大。

lemmas.def_en: (anatomy) a depression or fissure where vessels or nerves or ducts enter a bodily organ

examples.en: The tiny scar on the bean seed marks the position of the hilum.
examples.zh: 豆种上的细小疤痕标志着种脐的位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hilar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of living tissue) in a state of abnormally high tension

examples.en: The red blood cells quickly shrank when placed in a hypertonic solution.
examples.zh: 红细胞被放入高渗溶液中后迅速缩水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypertonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 本质, 根本原理, 原质
lemmas.def_en: the suppression of a gene by the effect of an unrelated gene

examples.en: Scholars discussed the hypostasis of beauty in ancient Greek philosophical thought.
examples.zh: 学者们探讨了古希腊哲学思想中美之本质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypostasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of lacking precision

examples.en: The project failed due to the imprecision of the original measurements.
examples.zh: 该项目因最初测量数据的不精确而失败。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imprecision 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 治不好地, 不能矫正地
lemmas.def_en: to an incurable degree

examples.en: He was incurably romantic, always sending flowers for no particular reason.
examples.zh: 他无可救药地浪漫，总是无缘无故地送花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incurably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知不觉地, 徐徐地
lemmas.def_en: in a numb manner; without feeling

examples.en: The afternoon warmth faded, and daylight insensibly slipped away into evening.
examples.zh: 午后的暖意褪去，白昼不知不觉地滑入了黄昏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insensibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可非难的, 无缺点的, 无过失的
lemmas.def_en: free of guilt; not subject to blame

examples.en: Throughout her long career, she maintained an irreproachable record of public service.
examples.zh: 在她漫长的职业生涯中，她的公共服务记录无可挑剔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irreproachable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a great rani; a princess in India or the wife of a maharaja

examples.en: The maharani wore a dazzling necklace of emeralds to the royal reception.
examples.zh: 王妃佩戴了一条耀眼的祖母绿项链出席皇家招待会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maharani 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who practices phlebotomy

examples.en: The skilled phlebotomist drew my blood quickly without causing any noticeable pain.
examples.zh: 熟练的抽血师动作敏捷，抽血时我几乎没感到疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phlebotomist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 户外工作, 外勤工作
lemmas.def_en: subsidiary defensive structure lying outside the main fortified area

examples.en: Soldiers were ordered to defend the fortified outwork against the sudden enemy assault.
examples.zh: 士兵们奉命防守坚固的外围工事，抵御敌人的突袭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the female ovule-bearing part of a flower composed of ovary and style and stigma

examples.en: Pollen grains must land on the sticky pistil for successful plant fertilization.
examples.zh: 花粉粒必须落在有粘性的雌蕊上才能成功完成植物受精。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pistil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猪舍, 猪舍似的地方, 污秽的场所, (总称)猪, 似猪的行为, 贪得无厌的习性
lemmas.def_en: a farm where pigs are raised or kept

examples.en: The farmer expanded his commercial piggery to meet the rising demand for pork.
examples.zh: 这位农民扩建了他的商业猪舍，以满足日益增长的猪肉需求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piggery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花斑的, 杂色的, 杂种的
lemmas.def_en: having sections or patches colored differently and usually brightly

examples.en: A handsome piebald horse galloped freely across the lush green meadow this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨，一匹英俊的花斑马在郁郁葱葱的草地上自由奔驰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piebald 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) the philosophical theory that matter is the only reality

examples.en: Modern philosophy of mind frequently debates whether physicalism can fully explain conscious experience.
examples.zh: 现代心灵哲学经常争论物理主义能否完全解释意识体验。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 physicalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a colorless poisonous gas that smells like new-mown hay; used in chemical warfare

examples.en: Phosgene was deployed as a lethal chemical weapon during the First World War.
examples.zh: 光气在第一次世界大战期间被用作一种致命的化学武器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phosgene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 法律管辖之外的, 不受法律支配的
lemmas.def_en: not regulated or sanctioned by law

examples.en: The corrupt regime used extralegal methods to silence critics without fair public trials.
examples.zh: 腐败政权利用法律管辖之外的手段压制批评者，不给公开公正的审判。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extralegal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 透孔织物, 透雕细工
lemmas.def_en: ornamental work (such as embroidery or latticework) having a pattern of openings

examples.en: She wore an elegant shawl decorated with delicate lace openwork for the gala.
examples.zh: 她披着一条饰有精致蕾丝透孔细工的高雅披肩参加了晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 openwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stupid foolish person

examples.en: Only an utter nincompoop would leave the front door wide open overnight like that.
examples.zh: 只有彻头彻尾的笨蛋才会那样整夜把前门敞开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nincompoop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a troupe of minstrels

examples.en: Medieval travelers were often entertained by wandering poets trained in the art of minstrelsy.
examples.zh: 中世纪的旅人经常得到受过吟游技艺训练的流浪诗人的娱乐款待。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minstrelsy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呜咽, 低声啜泣, 低声哭泣
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (literary or dated) To cry weakly and fretfully like a sick baby or young bird.

examples.en: The sick child began to pule softly until his mother gently comforted him.
examples.zh: 生病的孩子开始低声啜泣，直到母亲温柔地安抚他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精密细心的, 一丝不苟的, 拘泥形式的
lemmas.def_en: marked by precise accordance with details

examples.en: He was punctilious about paying all his bills several days before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他在截止日期前几天付清所有账单这一方面向来一丝不苟。

lemmas.def_zh: 谨小慎微地；拘泥细节地；一丝不苟地
lemmas.def_en: in a punctilious manner

examples.en: he launched into a long history of the birth of communism, giving credit punctiliously to the work of Marx and Engels

family_guide.root_logic: 以 punctilious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a group of very small rod-shaped bacteria that live in biting arthropods (as ticks and mites) and cause disease in vertebrate hosts; they cause typhus and other febrile diseases in human beings

examples.en: The laboratory technician identified rickettsia as the underlying pathogen causing the patient's fever.
examples.zh: 化验员确定立克次氏体是导致该患者发烧的潜在病原体。

lemmas.def_zh: [微] 里克次氏体属微生物的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by rickettsias

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rickettsia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (North American informal) To play or fight noisily and roughly without serious anger.

examples.en: The teacher warned the energetic boys not to roughhouse each other during recess.
examples.zh: 老师警告精力充沛的男孩们课间休息时不要互相粗暴打闹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roughhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (medicine) To listen to internal sounds of the heart, lungs, or abdomen using a stethoscope.

examples.en: The doctor used a stethoscope to auscultate the patient's chest for irregular sounds.
examples.zh: 医生用听诊器给病人的胸部听诊，以察看是否有异常杂音。

lemmas.def_en: listening to sounds within the body (usually with a stethoscope)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 auscultate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可破译的, 可判读的
lemmas.def_en: easily deciphered

examples.en: His faded handwriting on the old letter was barely decipherable after fifty years.
examples.zh: 五十年后，他在旧信上褪色的笔迹几乎难以辨认。

lemmas.def_zh: 破译不出的, 难辨认的
lemmas.def_en: not easily deciphered

examples.en: indecipherable handwriting

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decipherable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 军官公共生活室, 全体军官
lemmas.def_en: military quarters for dining and recreation for officers of a warship (except the captain)

examples.en: Naval officers gathered in the comfortable wardroom to relax after a stressful shift.
examples.zh: 海军军官们在紧张的轮班后聚集在舒适的军官生活室放松身心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wardroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: brittle flat bread eaten at Passover

examples.en: Traditional matzah is always served during the celebratory feast of the Passover meal.
examples.zh: 在逾越节的庆祝宴席上，人们总会食用传统的无酵饼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matzah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骄傲的, 自负的, 过于自信的, 过分的
lemmas.def_en: unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings

examples.en: His overweening arrogance ultimately led to the sudden downfall of his promising career.
examples.zh: 他那过分的傲慢最终导致了他大有前途的事业突然崩盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overweening 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rare heavy polyvalent metallic element that resembles manganese chemically and is used in some alloys; is obtained as a by-product in refining molybdenum

examples.en: Engineers use heat-resistant rhenium to manufacture specialized parts for modern jet turbine engines.
examples.zh: 工程师使用耐热的铼来制造现代喷气式涡轮发动机的专用零件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhenium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings

examples.en: The hiker noticed a strange rocky protuberance sticking out from the mountain cliff.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者注意到一块奇特的岩石突起从山崖上探了出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 突起的, 招人注意的
lemmas.def_en: curving outward

examples.en: He suffered a minor injury that left a protuberant bump on his forehead.
examples.zh: 他受了点轻伤，额头上留下了一个凸起的肿块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protuberance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to proprioception

examples.en: Sensory receptors provide crucial proprioceptive feedback that helps your body maintain steady balance.
examples.zh: 感觉受体提供关键的本体感受反馈，帮助身体保持稳定平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proprioceptive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一本正经的人, 纨绔子弟
lemmas.def_en: a person regarded as arrogant and annoying

examples.en: Nobody invited that unbearable prig because he constantly judged everyone else's harmless habits.
examples.zh: 没人邀请那个难以忍受的正经鬼，因为他总是对别人的无害习惯指手画脚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prig 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: public box for deposit of mail

examples.en: She dropped the postcard into the bright red postbox at the street corner.
examples.zh: 她把明信片投进了街角的鲜红色邮筒里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various pigments distributed widely in living tissues

examples.en: Excessive accumulation of porphyrin in the body can lead to severe metabolic disorders.
examples.zh: 体内卟啉的过量积累可能导致严重的代谢紊乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porphyrin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 平犬类；品犬；宾舍尔犬
lemmas.def_en: any of three breeds of dogs whose ears and tail are usually cropped

examples.en: The miniature pinscher barked energetically whenever a stranger approached the front gate.
examples.zh: 每当有陌生人靠近前门，那只迷你品犬就会精力充沛地狂吠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinscher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光线疗法, 光照疗法
lemmas.def_en: the use of strong light to treat acne or hyperbilirubinemia of the newborn

examples.en: The newborn baby received phototherapy to quickly treat his mild jaundice symptoms.
examples.zh: 新生儿接受了光疗以迅速治疗其轻度黄疸症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phototherapy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照相平印术, 照相平版印刷(法), 光刻法
lemmas.def_en: a planographic printing process using plates made from a photographic image

examples.en: Modern microchips are manufactured using advanced photolithography techniques on silicon wafers.
examples.zh: 现代微芯片是通过在硅晶圆上应用先进的光刻技术制造的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photolithography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可捆扎的；可打包的；可压紧的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being packed

examples.en: This lightweight packable jacket easily folds into its own pocket for travel.
examples.zh: 这件轻便的可折叠夹克很容易收纳进自带的口袋里，适合旅行携带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 packable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 藏骨堂, 骨灰瓮, 骨穴
lemmas.def_en: any receptacle for the burial of human bones

examples.en: Archaeologists carefully explored the ancient underground ossuary containing centuries-old human remains.
examples.zh: 考古学家仔细探查了这个存放着数百年人类遗骸的古老地下藏骨堂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ossuary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the large yellow root of a rutabaga plant used as food

examples.en: She chopped the rutabaga into small cubes before adding it to the stew.
examples.zh: 她把芜菁甘蓝切成小块，然后放入炖菜中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rutabaga 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 充填器, 闭塞具, 气密装置
lemmas.def_en: a prosthesis used to close an opening (as to close an opening of the hard palate in cases of cleft palate)

examples.en: The surgeon placed a custom obturator to cover the opening in the palate.
examples.zh: 外科医生放置了一个定制的闭塞具来遮盖腭部的缺损缺口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obturator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a moustache

examples.en: A tall mustachioed gentleman greeted the guests with a very warm, welcoming smile.
examples.zh: 一位留着八字胡的高个绅士带着极其热情热忱的微笑迎接客人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mustachioed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指中东的）穆斯林游击队员
lemmas.def_en: a military force of Muslim guerilla warriors engaged in a jihad

examples.en: The mujahedin fighters navigated the steep, rocky mountain passes in complete darkness.
examples.zh: 穆斯林游击队员在完全的黑暗中穿行于陡峭多石的山口之间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mujahedin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杂集, 杂记, 杂录
lemmas.def_en: a collection containing a variety of sorts of things

examples.en: The author published a delightful volume of miscellanea, including essays, poems, and sketches.
examples.zh: 作者出版了一部有趣的杂集，收录了随笔、诗歌和素描。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miscellanea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or in the region of the mastoid process

examples.en: The patient complained of throbbing pain behind the ear near the mastoid area.
examples.zh: 病人抱怨耳后乳突区附近有搏动性疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mastoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侏儒, 人体模特, 时装模特
lemmas.def_en: a person who is very small but who is not otherwise deformed or abnormal

examples.en: Nursing students practiced basic life support techniques on a realistic training manikin.
examples.zh: 护理专业学生在逼真的训练人体模型上练习了基础生命支持技能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manikin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of isocyanic acid

examples.en: Workers handling hazardous isocyanate chemicals must always wear protective respirators and gloves.
examples.zh: 处理危险异氰酸酯化学品的工人必须始终佩戴防毒面罩和手套。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isocyanate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: arising or occurring within a species; involving the members of one species

examples.en: The study observed intense intraspecific competition among adult male beetles for food resources.
examples.zh: 该研究观察到了成年雄性甲虫之间争夺食物资源的激烈种内竞争。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intraspecific 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: English form of rondeau having three triplets with a refrain after the first and third

examples.en: The vintage aircraft prominently displayed the national air force roundel on its wings.
examples.zh: 这架老式飞机的机翼上清晰地展示着国家空军的圆形机徽标志。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roundel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cracker sprinkled with salt before baking

examples.en: He nibbled on a plain saltine cracker to calm his upset stomach.
examples.zh: 他小口吃着一块原味撒盐苏打饼干，以缓解胃部不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saltine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能制胜的, 不能克服的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to surmount

examples.en: Despite facing seemingly insuperable odds, the determined team completed the project on time.
examples.zh: 尽管面对看似无法克服的重重困难，坚定的团队依然按时完成了项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insuperable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a three-legged metal stand for supporting a cooking vessel in a hearth

examples.en: Please place the hot metal pot directly onto the trivet to protect the table.
examples.zh: 请把滚烫的金属锅直接放在隔热三脚架上，以免烫坏桌面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trivet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (犹太男子在祷告,学习,吃饭等时戴的)圆顶小帽
lemmas.def_en: a skullcap worn by religious Jews (especially at prayer)

examples.en: The boy adjusted his velvet yarmulke before walking respectfully into the historic synagogue.
examples.zh: 男孩在恭敬地走进历史悠久的犹太会堂前整理了一下自己的丝绒圆顶小帽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yarmulke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a purulent infection at the end of a finger or toe in the area surrounding the nail

examples.en: A painful whitlow had developed around the cuticle of her swollen index finger.
examples.zh: 她肿胀的食指甲床周围长了一个令人疼痛的瘭疽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitlow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: light easily worked wood of a tulip tree; used for furniture and veneer

examples.en: The carpenter selected smooth whitewood boards to build the simple kitchen cabinets.
examples.zh: 木匠挑选了光滑的白色木板来制作简易的厨房橱柜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitewood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large marine snail much used as food in Europe

examples.en: The fisherman found a large whelk clinging to the wet sea rocks.
examples.zh: 渔民在湿漉漉的海边岩石上发现了一只大峨螺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whelk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水轮, 水车, 辘轳
lemmas.def_en: a wheel with buckets attached to its rim; raises water from a stream or pond

examples.en: The old wooden waterwheel turned slowly, powered by the rushing river current.
examples.zh: 古老的水车在湍急河水的推动下缓缓转动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterwheel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a district or province governed by a viceroy

examples.en: During his viceroyalty, the governor built several major roads across the province.
examples.zh: 在他的总督任期内，该总督在全省修建了几条主要道路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viceroyalty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可原谅的, 可宽恕的, 轻微的
lemmas.def_en: warranting only temporal punishment

examples.en: The teacher considered his minor tardiness to be a venial offense.
examples.zh: 老师认为他轻微的迟到是完全可以原谅的过失。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 venial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脉序, 叶脉, 脉络, 纹理
lemmas.def_en: (botany) the arrangement of veins in a leaf

examples.en: The distinct venation of the leaf helps scientists identify the rare plant.
examples.zh: 这片叶子独特的脉序有助于科学家辨识这种珍稀植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 venation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a highly contagious viral disease characterized by fever and weakness and skin eruption with pustules that form scabs that slough off leaving scars

examples.en: Global vaccination campaigns finally led to the complete eradication of variola.
examples.zh: 全球疫苗接种运动最终彻底消灭了天花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 variola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 转子(解剖); 转节(昆虫)
lemmas.def_en: one of the bony prominences developed near the upper extremity of the femur to which muscles are attached

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the fracture near the greater trochanter of the femur.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了股骨大转子附近的骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trochanter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 兽脚亚目食肉恐龙(前肢小, 主要用后肢行走)
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous carnivorous dinosaurs of the Triassic to Cretaceous with short forelimbs that walked or ran on strong hind legs

examples.en: Tyrannosaurus rex is perhaps the most famous theropod known to modern science.
examples.zh: 霸王龙或许是现代科学中所知最著名的兽脚亚目恐龙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 theropod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the complete mismanagement or mishandling of a situation

examples.en: The major scheduling screwup forced the airline to cancel several flights.
examples.zh: 严重的排班失误迫使航空公司取消了数架航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 screwup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: n. [有时用作单](犹太教) 经文护符匣
lemmas.def_en: (Judaism) either of two small leather cases containing texts from the Hebrew Scriptures (known collectively as tefillin); traditionally worn (on the forehead and the left arm) by Jewish men during morning prayer

examples.en: He traditionally binds tefillin to his arm and forehead during morning prayers.
examples.zh: 在晨祷时，他按照传统将经文护符匣绑在手臂和额头上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tefillin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: appendage added to extend the length of something

examples.en: The luthier attached the strings to the finely crafted ebony tailpiece.
examples.zh: 琴师把琴弦固定在做工精美的乌木弦板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailpiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化]琥珀 的, 丁二酸的, 琥珀酸的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or obtained from amber

examples.en: The laboratory synthesized succinic acid for use in eco-friendly plastic production.
examples.zh: 实验室合成了用于环保塑料生产的琥珀酸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 succinic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any vertical post or rod used as a support

examples.en: He leaned against the metal stanchion while waiting for the morning train.
examples.zh: 等早班火车时，他靠在金属支柱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stanchion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (被风刮在一起的)雪堆, 随风飘飞的雪
lemmas.def_en: a mass of snow heaped up by the wind

examples.en: The storm created a massive snowdrift that completely blocked the front door.
examples.zh: 暴风雪堆起了一座巨大的雪堆，完全堵住了前门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowdrift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mound or heap of snow

examples.en: His car slid off the icy road directly into a deep snowbank.
examples.zh: 他的车滑下了结冰的公路，直接冲进了厚厚的雪堤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowbank 为核心的派生词族。
